title: Social Art Director & Videographer - Madrid
description:
**¿Quiénes somos?**
-------------------


Somos una consultora internacional especializada en impulsar la evolución de los modelos de negocio de grandes y medianas empresas. Ayudamos a nuestros clientes a mejorar su competitividad conectando estrategia, comunicación, diseño, tecnología y datos, siempre con un enfoque práctico y orientado a generar impacto.


Contamos con un equipo de más de 2\.000 profesionales distribuidos en distintos países y trabajamos en proyectos end\-to\-end, acompañando a nuestros clientes desde la definición estratégica hasta la implementación, la medición y la optimización continua. Nuestro objetivo es transformar los datos en decisiones de negocio que generen resultados reales.


En esta ocasión, estamos colaborando con **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, en la búsqueda de talento para incorporar a su equipo y cubrir esta posición.

**¿Qué es Cosmic?**
-------------------

**Cosmic** es una agencia especializada en **Short Vertical Video**, el formato que domina plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts. Como primer partner creativo de TikTok en Europa, ayuda a las marcas a conectar con sus audiencias a través de contenidos nativos, creativos y diseñados para maximizar su impacto.


Su equipo se encarga de diseñar, producir y optimizar contenidos que destacan en las plataformas donde hoy se generan las conversaciones y las tendencias, combinando creatividad, estrategia y un profundo conocimiento del ecosistema digital.

### **¿Qué buscamos?**

**¿Sabes que un buen TikTok no es un spot de 30 segundos puesto en vertical?**


Buscamos un/a **Social Art Director \& Videographer** con un ojo creativo brutal y una sensibilidad especial por el lenguaje de cada plataforma. Alguien que entienda qué hace que una idea funcione en social y que sea capaz de llevarla de principio a fin: **conceptualizarla, grabarla, editarla y convertirla en contenido que la gente quiera ver y compartir.**


No buscamos solo a alguien que sepa hacer vídeos bonitos. Buscamos a alguien que **entienda el lenguaje de internet, tenga criterio visual y sepa convertir una buena idea en contenido que funcione.**

### **Eres perfecto/a si**

* **Tienes 3\+ años de experiencia** en dirección de arte, diseño creativo o creación audiovisual, idealmente en agencia creativa, digital, productora o entorno social\-first.
* **Tu portfolio habla por ti.** Demuestra criterio visual, buenas ideas y, sobre todo, capacidad real para llevarlas a ejecución.
* **Tienes obsesión por el detalle.** Composición, fotografía, tipografía, color, ritmo… sabes que son los pequeños detalles los que hacen que una pieza pase de correcta a memorable.
* **Piensas en movimiento desde el principio.** No diseñas primero una pieza gráfica para convertirla después en vídeo: piensas en imagen, cámara, ritmo y narrativa desde el minuto uno.
* **Entiendes el lenguaje de cada plataforma.** Sabes que lo que funciona en TikTok no necesariamente funciona en Instagram o YouTube, y adaptas la idea sin perder su esencia.
* **Te mueves bien entre lo grande y lo rápido.** Puedes trabajar en una producción con todos los recursos o sacar adelante una pieza que tiene que estar publicada mañana.
* **Eres resourceful.** No necesitas una gran producción para hacer algo bueno: sabes sacar partido a un móvil, un equipo pequeño y los recursos que tengas a mano.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades incluso cuando nadie te ha dado todavía un brief.

### **¿Qué harás?**

* **Convertir ideas en contenido.** Conceptualizar y desarrollar ideas visuales y audiovisuales para campañas, contenido always\-on y oportunidades culturales en social.
* **Marcar la dirección visual.** Definir el look \& feel de contenidos y activaciones, construyendo una identidad reconocible sin caer en fórmulas o plantillas repetitivas.
* **Dar forma a las ideas.** Crear tratamientos visuales, referencias, moodboards, storyboards y planteamientos de realización que hagan que una idea cobre vida antes de llegar a producción.
* **Grabar y producir.** Coger una cámara o un smartphone y sacar adelante una pieza de principio a fin, adaptando los recursos a lo que necesita cada idea.
* **Resolver en modo social\-first.** Desde entrevistas y producto hasta creators, coberturas, contenido reactivo y formatos que necesitan salir rápido. Sabes moverte con soltura cuando el contexto cambia.
* **Editar y llevar las piezas hasta el final.** Montaje, ritmo, grafismo, motion, sonido y color, cuidando tanto el conjunto como cada detalle.
* **Pensar en cada plataforma.** Adaptar conceptos y piezas para TikTok, Reels, Stories, Shorts, YouTube, LinkedIn y otros formatos digitales, entendiendo qué funciona en cada entorno.
* **Trabajar pegado al equipo de contenido.** Colaborar con Content Manager y Social Intelligence para convertir tendencias, insights y oportunidades editoriales en ideas visuales que merezca la pena producir.
* **Experimentar con IA.** Incorporar herramientas generativas en tu proceso de ideación, preproducción y exploración visual, trabajando junto al AI Content Producer cuando la pieza requiera workflows más complejos.
* **Sacar lo mejor de los creators.** Dirigir a personas delante de cámara de forma natural, ágil y sin convertir cada grabación en un rodaje de película.
* **Defender tus ideas.** Presentar y argumentar conceptos y decisiones visuales ante equipos internos y clientes, sabiendo explicar no solo qué propones, sino por qué funciona.

### **Lo que tienes que dominar**

* **Portfolio con criterio.** Experiencia demostrable en creatividad social y audiovisual, con piezas que demuestren tanto buen ojo como capacidad de ejecución.
* **Cámara y móvil.** Capacidad profesional para grabar con cámara y smartphone, sabiendo elegir el equipo y el enfoque según lo que necesite cada pieza.
* **Lenguaje audiovisual.** Conocimientos sólidos de fotografía, composición, iluminación, encuadre, movimiento y narrativa audiovisual.
* **Herramientas de creación.** Dominio de Adobe Creative Cloud —Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere y After Effects— y soltura con herramientas ágiles como CapCut.
* **Código social.** Conocimiento profundo de formatos, duraciones, hooks, ritmo y códigos visuales y narrativos de TikTok, Instagram/Reels y YouTube/Shorts.
* **IA aplicada a la creatividad.** Familiaridad con herramientas de IA generativa y criterio para incorporarlas en la ideación, preproducción y producción audiovisual cuando realmente aporten valor.

**Cómo trabajas**
-----------------

* **Piensas y haces a la vez.** Te gusta conceptualizar, pero también coger la cámara, probar, grabar y resolver. No eres de los que se quedan en la idea.
* **Sabes que manda la plataforma.** Entiendes sus códigos, su ritmo y lo que hace que una pieza funcione en cada canal. No haces “un vídeo y luego lo adaptas”: piensas nativamente para cada plataforma.
* **Encuentras el equilibrio.** Sabes mantener la identidad de marca sin perder relevancia cultural ni convertir cada contenido en una pieza demasiado corporativa.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades sin esperar a que llegue un brief perfectamente cerrado.

**¿Te gustaría crecer con nosotros/as?**
----------------------------------------


Si buscas un entorno donde la creatividad, la comunicación y la estrategia se unen para generar un impacto real en el negocio, esta puede ser tu oportunidad.


En esta ocasión, te incorporarás a **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, donde formarás parte de un equipo que está redefiniendo la forma en la que las marcas conectan con sus audiencias a través del contenido en plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts.


Si te apasionan los retos, la innovación y el entorno digital, ¡queremos conocerte!


En línea con nuestro compromiso con la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión, animamos a todas las personas a presentar su candidatura, especialmente a quienes forman parte de colectivos tradicionalmente infrarrepresentados, como las personas LGTBIQ\+ o las personas con discapacidad.

description:
**Clash of Clans is one of the most recognisable games ever made. We want to keep it that way, and then some.**
 Clash is growing beyond the game, showing up in trailers, campaigns, toys, and collaborations. The visual identity has to stretch to cover all of it, stay true to what players love, and still feel fresh. We're also modernising how we make things: pipelines are evolving, our content production is scaling, and we're working more closely with external partners than ever before.
   

  

 We need someone who can own this at a strategic level. Someone who sets the vision, builds the conditions for great work, and steers the IP with confidence across every surface it touches.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Define and evolve the visual direction of Clash across the game, cosmetics, and wherever else the IP lives. True to its DNA, but never frozen in time.
* Set the standard for style and brand fit across in\-game art, marketing, trailers, toy lines, campaigns, and entertainment partners, and empower the team to uphold it.
* Partner with game design, product, and marketing leadership to ensure art strategy supports gameplay clarity, player understanding, and long\-term brand health.
* Mentor and support Clash artists, help them do the best work of their careers while staying aligned on the IP.
* Shape the roadmap for modernising Clash pipelines (2D to 3D, audio, tooling, and emerging technologies), championing approaches that give artists more time for the work only they can do.
* Represent art at a senior level across the business: outsourcing partners, Entertainment and Partnerships, marketing, and franchise collaborators.


 What You Have
   

  

* A strong track record leading art direction on stylised games. Mobile and live\-service experience is a big plus.
* Deep IP and brand instincts, the ability to define what's on\-brand vs off and build the frameworks that help a whole team make that call consistently.
* Leadership experience on a highly collaborative senior art teams: setting vision, developing artists, and making the culture as strong as the output.
* Strategic experience managing outsourcing pipelines and external partners at scale, balancing quality ambitions with the realities of live\-game timelines and budgets.
* Comfort operating in a low\-process, high\-trust environment where you own the outcomes, not just the opinions.
* A self\-starter approach to use AI. You've found ways to use it in your day\-to\-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.


 Would Be Nice if You Also Have
   

  

* Experience with cosmetics economies or large seasonal content pipelines.
* Experience bridging game art strategy and marketing/UA: key art, trailers, social.
* Familiarity with Clash (as a player or from prior work) and a feel for how it's evolved.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

 This role can be based either in Helsinki or London. Clash of Clans team members are located in both our Helsinki and London Studios however most of our Artists are located in Helsinki!
   

  

 To be successful, you'll be expected to travel regularly in this role especially if based out of London.
   

  

 –––
   

  

*That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.*
*Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.*
*–––*
**About Supercell**
 Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of
 *Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars* 
 . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
   

  

 So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.
   

  

 Hey, You Might Love It Here!
   

  

 Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.
   

  

 You Are Not Your Job Title ™
   

  

 Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.
   

  

**Benefits And Compensation**
 Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.
   

  

 Relocation? Yes!
   

  

 No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!
   

  

 Not Sure if You Should Apply?
   

  

 Many candidates with great skills and experience second\-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.
   

  

 Wishing you all the best,
   

  

 The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Head of Design, AI-First
description:
**Own the design function for a $1Billion\+ brand. Transform how we build with AI.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $181,500 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path** 
 from here is VP Design → Chief Design Officer. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere can happen in 1\-2 years here for high performers.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every design proposal ships with an AI review link, and Figma AI runs in our live production pipeline, shipping real work. You'd start where most teams are still trying to get.
 



  





*This position is remote, with the option to work from our Dubai office (with 0% income tax), if preferred (relocation and visa sponsorship support available).* 




  





**Role Overview** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Head of Design to turn our end\-to\-end web design from a sequential production queue into a fast, AI\-native operation. You will build on our existing AI adoption by establishing consistent workflows, prompt infrastructure, quality controls and system governance that let high\-quality design work ship at volume without extending timelines. While you own the visual and structural execution of the site, you will partner closely with the CRO team, which owns experimentation, including test hypotheses and the conversion roadmap.
 



  





**The Career Accelerator** 




 You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce:** 
 very few Heads of Design get simultaneous ownership over the design system, the AI toolchain, the design roadmap and accessibility standards while leading a team of three as a hands\-on player coach and reporting directly to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion. This is not a role where you just review other people's mockups and forward them to engineering. Instead, you are building the operating system for the entire design function.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 rebuild the design workflow from sequential to agile, with kickoff huddles and a 40% reduction in time from design concept to development handoff. Build the prompt library and review workflow covering product copy, FAQs, size/fit guidance, policy explainers, and localized variants. Design the UI patterns for conversational search, guided finders, and PDP Q\&A alongside engineering. Own the recommendation surfaces — placements, card density, "why this" microcopy — and validate them with staged rollouts. Evolve the design system so tokens and components absorb AI\-generated variants without brand drift or PageSpeed cost. Bake WCAG 2\.2 into the system and pair AI\-assisted audits with manual review. Feed the experimentation roadmap with design variants that the CRO team can test at pace, and turn winning patterns into reusable standards across the design system. Shape the future of design at Puffy, where the site is the entire storefront and every conversion point runs through your team.



  





**What Is In It For You** 




 This isn't just another design management role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Design Function and the Toolchain It Runs On** 




 You set the standard, build the workflow, and own what ships.
 


* You design the operating model for the whole function: how work enters the queue, how AI\-generated variants get validated, where human QA sits, and how a spec reaches Dev Mode without losing intent. You own IA, wireframes, high\-fidelity comps, prototypes, and motion specs across Home, PLP, PDP, Cart/Checkout, editorial, and paid\-media landing pages. You decide what the design system tolerates and what it rejects.
* You hold the line on WCAG 2\.2, PageSpeed, and brand consistency while the volume goes up. You’re accountable for design quality, delivery speed, and the design team's contribution to conversion lift. You report to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion, present quarterly design roadmap reviews and translate design decisions \& experiment results into a narrative that the business acts on.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 




 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
 



 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
 



 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space or our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Design Leader Other Brands Come Looking For** 




 In most companies, design leaders inherit a workflow somebody else built and spend their tenure defending its timelines in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides what ships next quarter, your design roadmap is the input to that decision, not a status report on it afterwards. You'll leave with an AI\-native design operation you designed end to end — and the handoff\-time and conversion numbers proving quality held while volume went up, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than a versioning queue in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need** 



* 7\+ years in web design for e\-commerce, including 4\+ years leading, mentoring, and managing the operations of a design team.
* A portfolio that shows shipped PDP/PLP/Checkout improvements tied to clear business metrics.

 Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.
   

  

 Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross\-departmental execution with editorial teams. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high\-stakes, multi\-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi\-market event sponsorships.

* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.

They should understand performance creative as a system of hypotheses, tests, learnings, and scalable winners—not just brand execution or asset quality.


Success means helping Directive replace deliverable\-based requests with campaign briefs grounded in business objectives, buyer insight, test variables, and success metrics. The ACD should raise the quality of creative thinking before work reaches production, improve how Directive communicates to technical and enterprise buyers, and create the foundation for a scalable performance creative practice.

 **WILL OWN**

**Campaign Strategy**


The ACD owns the idea, message, and creative direction before production begins — and helps prove that better campaign thinking can create better performance, stronger pitches, and more creative revenue.

* Support new\-business and portfolio\-sales opportunities with speculative creative, campaign narratives, and stronger creative presence in strategic pitches.
* Create the foundation for Directive’s strategic creative approach.
* Primary responsibility is creative direction, campaign concepting, messaging strategy, and performance copy direction.
* Turns campaign and creative briefs into territories, concepts, hooks, headlines, CTAs, landing\-page narrative direction, and message sequencing.
* Partners with designers by giving them a strong concept and copy direction to execute against.
* Builds the early proof points, examples, and campaign\-style case studies needed to support future creative revenue growth.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

**30\-day success signal:** Internal teams understand why this role exists, what it owns, and how creative requests should start shifting from asset asks to campaign briefs.

* Audited current creative requests, briefs, production workflows, pitch materials, and performance creative examples.
* Met with Creative Production, Paid Media, Growth, Sales, Account leadership, and executive stakeholders to understand opportunities.
* Defined what a “good” campaign brief needs to include before work enters production.
* Created a first draft of the campaign creative brief template tied to Moments that Matter / Stratos.
* Identified 2–3 priority use cases where the new model can prove value quickly, such as strategic account pitches, paid social campaigns, ABM campaigns, or portfolio\-sales opportunities.
* Produced at least one example of a stronger campaign territory or messaging direction from an existing work.

**90\-day success signal:** Directive can point to live examples where creative strategy made the work sharper before production began, and stakeholders feel the new process is improving clarity, quality, and pitch readiness.

* Run several real briefs through a campaign\-level creative process: insight, hypothesis, concept, copy direction, production handoff, launch, and learning.
* Developed creative territories, messaging angles, campaign copy, and testing recommendations for priority initiatives.
* Supported at least one new\-business, strategic account, or portfolio\-sales opportunity with speculative or campaign\-style creative.
* Built a working partnership model with production designers so designers are executing against clearer concepts and copy direction.
* Created early examples of campaign\-style case studies or internal proof points.
* Established a lightweight creative review rhythm focused on concept quality, message clarity, testability, and business relevance.
* Begun defining the message/proof library and taxonomy needed for learning to compound across campaigns.
* You have an established creative testing rhythm: hypothesis variant data decision, repeatable without manual oversight.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Experience \& Portfolio**

**Creative Expertise**

* 4–6 years of professional creative experience, with a meaningful portion in an agency, professional services, or B2B marketing environment
* A portfolio that shows range across brand work and performance creative — we need to see both a visual system you built and an ad campaign you designed that drove measurable results
* Experience developing campaigns from concept through execution.
* Ability to maintain and evolve brand standards across multiple channels.

**Strategic and Business Skills**

* Understanding of creative strategy and storytelling.
* Ability to translate ICP, positioning, personas, JTBD insights, proof points, objections, and funnel\-stage context into creative hypotheses and campaign concepts.
* Executive presence and confidence presenting creative strategy in new\-business, portfolio\-sales, client\-facing, or leadership settings.
* Strong understanding of performance creative, testing methodology, message iteration, pipeline influence, and revenue\-oriented creative measurement.
* Ability to partner effectively with production designers, paid media strategists, Account Directors, Growth, and Sales without needing to personally execute design production.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and helping shape the brief when the request is not fully formed.

**Technical and Industry Knowledge**

* Digital marketing and social media
* UX/UI design
* Video and motion graphics
* Content strategy
* Creative software such as Adobe Creative Cloud
* AI\-assisted creative tools and emerging technologies

**Tools — Required**

* Adobe Creative Suite — Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign (expert level)
* Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro — proficient; you can produce and deliver without a separate editor
* Figma — design systems, component libraries, collaborative handoff
* Familiarity with A/B testing and CRO tools — Optimizely, Unbounce, Crazy Egg, or equivalent
* Heavy reliance and comfortability with generative AI and a recommended tool\-set day 1\.

**Tools — Preferred**

* Project management tools — Asana, or similar; you will work within an existing PM workflow
* Familiarity with a marketing analytics stack — GA4, Looker, or similar; you can read a dashboard and extract creative implications independently

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $120,000\-$130,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.
* Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle


	+ Including a 100% employer\-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents
* Benefits to Support the Whole Person:


	+ Mental \- Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
	+ Physical \- Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
	+ Time Off \- Unlimited PTO (2\-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 \- January 1\), Paid Parental Leave
	+ Financial \- Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
	+ Bonus \- Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**


Directive is a remote\-first company. This role operates 100% virtually from your home office. We collaborate through Zoom and Slack. You will need a reliable setup, high\-speed internet, and a professional working environment capable of running Adobe Creative Suite and video production software without interruption.


We accommodate global candidates in markets where Directive has established business operations, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. Current, permanent work authorization in that country is required. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, operate design and video software on Mac or PC, and observe and interpret written and verbal communication consistently. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities — contact recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**


At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.


If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

title: Creative Director
description:
As a
 **Creative Director,** 
 you will turn complex business goals into compelling creative ideas. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, lead client conversations, and create the clarity people need to do their best work. You will also use AI thoughtfully to support research, exploration, and workflow efficiency while keeping strategy, judgment, and final approval human\-led.
 



  





 Designity is a premium, AI\-enabled and human\-led Creative\-as\-a\-Service company. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director\-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI\-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Our clients are managing ambitious business goals, changing priorities, and creative needs that span brands, campaigns, digital experiences, motion, and content.
 



  





 They need more than strong execution. They need a senior creative leader who can find the strategic opportunity, establish a clear direction, assemble the right team, and protect quality from the first conversation through final delivery.

* **Set the creative vision** 
 \- Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and project types, including brand platforms, campaigns, visual identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.

* **Develop creative talent** 
 \- Help creative professionals strengthen their judgment and craft through direct feedback, clear expectations, and thoughtful mentorship.

 Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection. You will work across client relationships, creative disciplines, and changing priorities.
 



  





 At least six hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is required so you can lead conversations, collaborate with teams, and make timely decisions.,

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W\-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast\-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards

 and lift those around you.
* **Say It Straight** 
 with honesty and respect.
* **Raise the Bar** 
 by never settling for average.
* **Take Ownership** 
 of your work and your impact.
* **Move with Purpose** 
 and make every action count.

* Creating work that is both strategically sound and creatively outstanding.
* Becoming a trusted creative partner to clients and internal teams.
* Elevating the quality of ideas, execution, and storytelling.
* Helping teams do their best work through clear feedback and mentorship.

 Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.

 You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high\-performing, on\-brand work at scale.  Design the end\-to\-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.

 Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test\-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in\-person moments.
   

  

 Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.

* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance\-driven digital work.
* Hands\-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct\-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems\-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.

Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
   

  

 Base Pay Range

description:
**About The Role**
 Chime is looking for a Creative Director to shape what our brand looks, sounds and feels like — and to turn that into work people actually talk about.
   

  

 This is an in\-house creative leadership role on our Brand \& Creative Marketing team. You will set the creative vision for integrated campaigns and carry it through every expression of the brand: brand films and broadcast, social\-first work, partnerships and activations, and the always\-on content that keeps a brand present between campaigns. You will lead a small in\-house team of art directors, designers and copywriters, and direct the external agencies, production companies and partners who help scale the work.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who thinks in platforms rather than executions — who can find the idea that holds up across a :30, a partnership, a feed and a retail moment. You should be comfortable pitching bold top\-of\-funnel brand work while understanding how the rest of the funnel earns it: campaigns that build awareness, move consideration and support conversion, and that stay honestly connected to what the business needs.
   

  

 The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $201,000\.00 and up to $279,000\.00\. Full\-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
   

  

 In this role, you can expect to
   

  

* Set and evolve the creative vision for the Chime brand, and translate it into storytelling that drives awareness and consideration
* Lead integrated campaigns end to end — from platform and concept through production and final execution — across brand film and broadcast, social, partnerships, activations and owned channels
* Champion bold ideas, and make the case for them clearly to marketing, product and executive stakeholders
* Build creative that travels: social\-first thinking, talent and partner collaborations, and moments designed to be shared rather than served
* Partner with brand, growth, product marketing and media leads so that campaign ideas hold up across the full funnel and are measurable against business goals
* Lead, mentor and grow a team of art directors, designers and copywriters, and set the standard for the quality of work the team ships
* Run creative reviews and brainstorms that raise the level of the idea, with clear direction and feedback people can act on
* Manage external creative agencies, production houses, and media and talent partners, and hold them to the same bar
* Use the tools that make a modern creative team faster — including AI in concepting, iteration and production — and help the team adopt what genuinely works
* Keep a sharp read on our members, the category and the cultural landscape, and let it shape the work


 To thrive in this role, you have
   

  

* 8\+ years in creative leadership, including at least 5 leading brand\-level work
* A portfolio of consumer\-facing campaigns you can walk us through — the strategic problem, the idea, and what happened
* At least one brand platform you built or meaningfully shaped that changed how people saw a company
* Experience in a creative agency environment, and the craft standard that comes with it
* Work that has run in more than one form: brand film or broadcast produced with agency and production partners, social\-native work, and partnership or activation initiatives
* A track record leading and developing a small in\-house creative team, and getting the best out of external partners
* Fluency across the funnel, including the view that lower\-funnel work is a creative problem too
* Excellent communication and presentation skills — you can sell an idea into a skeptical room and explain why it is right
* Practical experience using AI tools in the creative process, and a point of view on where they help and where they do not


**A Little About Us**
 At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank\*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user\-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.
   

  

 We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out\-hustle and out\-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.
   

  

 We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.
   

  

 We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.
   

  

 Because if we don't—who will?
   

  

* Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.


**What We Offer For Our Full\-time, Regular Employees**
* 🏢 Our in\-office work policy is designed to keep you connected \- with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company\-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
* 💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
* ✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
* 🏝 Generous vacation policy and company\-wide paid days off
* 🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
* 👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
* 👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non\-birthing parents
* 👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
* 💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress


 We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.
   

  

 Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cook County Ordinance, NYC Fair Chance Act, and the LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and consistent with Canadian provincial and federal laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact: accommodations@chime.com.

title: Associate Design Director, CDMX (Mexico City, Remote)
description:
***Who are we?***
 MATTE is a 360° full\-service creative studio at the convergence of hype, storytelling and design. We bring people together to inspire new ways of engaging, to provoke long term progress, and to entertain audiences around the world, while helping forward\-thinking brands and institutions nimbly and truly do the same. Our studio capabilities range from strategic ideation and insights, creative development, branding and identity, experiential, web design and development, campaigns and content creation, all the way through full\-scale production and execution.
   

  

 Location: Mexico City, Mexico
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time Contract
   

  

 Work Model: Remote
   

  

*Role Overview*
 MATTE is seeking an Associate Design Director to join our Mexico City creative team on a full\-time contract basis. This role is ideal for a highly conceptual, visually sophisticated designer who can lead projects while remaining actively involved in the work.
   

  

 The Associate Design Director will help translate creative strategy into compelling visual systems and oversee design across brand identities, campaigns, digital experiences, content, and experiential projects. They will partner closely with creative leadership, designers, strategists, producers, and account teams to ensure the work is conceptually strong, beautifully executed, and consistent across every touchpoint.
   

  

 This is a remote position for candidates based in Mexico. The individual must be available to collaborate during working hours aligned with MATTE's New York and Mexico City teams.
   

  

*Key Responsibilities*
* Lead the visual development and execution of integrated creative projects from concept through delivery.
* Develop brand identities, design systems, campaign toolkits, presentations, digital experiences, and experiential applications.
* Translate creative concepts and strategic insights into clear, compelling visual directions.
* Remain hands\-on throughout the design process while providing direction, feedback, and mentorship to other designers.
* Oversee multiple projects and workstreams while maintaining a consistently high standard of craft.
* Create and present design concepts to internal teams, senior leadership, and clients.
* Collaborate with creative directors, art directors, copywriters, strategists, producers, developers, and external partners.
* Ensure visual consistency across digital, social, content, environmental, and physical brand touchpoints.
* Help strengthen the CDMX design team's processes, capabilities, and creative culture.
* Stay current on developments in design, technology, culture, AI, and emerging creative tools.


**Qualifications**
* Approximately 7\+ years of experience in design, branding, advertising, or a related creative field.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft, conceptual thinking, and experience building cohesive design systems.
* Experience leading design across multiple channels, including brand, campaign, digital, social, content, and experiential work.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.
* Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate creative decisions.
* Experience directing and mentoring designers while remaining hands\-on in the work.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced agency environment.
* Professional fluency in English and Spanish is strongly preferred.
* Experience working with international teams or global brands is a plus.


*Compensation: $10,000\-11,000 USD per month*
*Contract Structure*
*This is a remote, full\-time contract position for an individual based in Mexico. The contractor is expected to maintain full\-time availability and work as an embedded member of MATTE's creative team for the duration of the engagement. Specific contract length, compensation, invoicing requirements, and renewal terms will be outlined in the applicable services agreement.*

title: Performance Creative Director
description:
**KittySpout / DoggySpout** 
 is looking for a
 **Performance Creative Strategist** 
 to join our team! As our creative strategist, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a heavy focus on Meta VSLs, UGC ads, and high\-converting direct response ads \- short and long form \- that scale across our paid channels. We spend $2,000,000\+ per month on Meta. We are looking to hire someone with 3\+ years of experience. The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience in performance creative, runs a current AI stack in production, has experience briefing short and long form VSLs and delivers volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest\-growing brands in the pet space — $22M\+ in revenue and targeting $45\-50M in 2026\. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.
   

  

**What is our culture like \& who is a good fit?**
 Culture\-fit is our \#1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will\-to\-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less \- and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better everyday. We love learning \- every problem is an opportunity to grow.
   

  

**If you want a stress\-free corporate 9\-5 job, this isn't it.**
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast\-growing company, work directly with the founders, and see huge career growth by playing a big role in scaling it to $100m\+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, and play a big part in our growth being hands\-on and active, all while having a generous performance bonus structure — then you've come to the right place.
   

  

**Key Objectives:**
* Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis
* Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives
* Script Direct response creatives
* Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives
* Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas
* Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
* Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
* Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative
* Produce a minimum of 15 ad briefs per week, maintaining volume and quality simultaneously — without being chased


**Requirements**
* Fully remote
* Fluent in English
* Direct Response Expertise: 3\+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must
* Strong analytical skills with hands\-on experience interpreting performance data from platforms such as Northbeam, Facebook Ads, leveraging spreadsheets and reporting tools to extract insights, inform strategy and communicate campaign ideas and results
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn't know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
* Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders
* Proven VSL copywriting experience on DR / performance brands
* Deep DTC Experience: You can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work — not just categories
* Meta VSLs: Proven experience with both short and long form Meta VSLs. Long form is the bulk of what we run
* AI Stack: You run a current AI stack in production — not one you tried once
* Output: You deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased
* Deep fluency with DTC and modern consumer brands


**Examples of What You'll Be Doing:**
* Develop VSL briefings end\-to\-end: angle, hook, script, structure
* Design AI\-driven concepts and hooks for paid video
* Partner with editors and performance marketers on testing
* Iterate strategy based on creative performance data


**How Our Hiring Works \& How We Operate:**
 We review applications on a rolling basis and keep strong candidates in our talent bench. If you're a great fit and the timing isn't right immediately, you'll be first in line when a spot opens. Our process has three stages:
   

  

* Application Review \+ Screening \- we assess your background and experience to confirm mutual fit
* Technical Interview \+ Creative Brief \- a short practical exercise so we can see how you think and work
* Culture Fit Interview \- a final conversation with the founder to make sure this is the right team for you and you're the right person for us


 KPIs and performance targets will be defined together before your start date so expectations are crystal clear from day one.
   

  

**Salary Expectation**
 USD $3,000 \- $6,000 per month base (based on experience and expertise) \+ percentage of ad spend bonus structure.
   

  

**We spend $2,000,000\+ per month on Meta only.**

title: Creative Director- Interior Design
description:
1\.1 The Creative Director is the custodian of EVA Interiors’ creative vision, design quality, and aesthetic integrity across all interior design, architectural, and FF\&E outputs.
 



 1\.2 The role exists to institutionalize creativity at EVA Interiors by transforming creative vision into clear standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks, ensuring consistency, excellence, and repeatable quality at scale.
 



 1\.3 The Creative Director ensures that EVA’s creative output reflects a luxury positioning that is innovative, disciplined, commercially viable, and execution\-ready, while continuously evolving to remain relevant and distinctive in the market.
 



  





**2\.1 Creative Vision, Guidelines \& Governance** 



* The Creative Director defines, documents, and continuously refines EVA Interiors’ creative philosophy and design language, ensuring that spatial principles, material hierarchy, detailing standards, colour strategies, and FF\&E integration are formalised within approved governance frameworks.
* The role ensures that all creative outputs demonstrably comply with documented standards, and that any deviation is formally identified, evaluated, and addressed through structured corrective governance mechanisms rather than informal tolerance.
* The Creative Director maintains executive oversight of all design\-related SOPs to ensure sustained alignment between creative integrity, structured workflows, and disciplined project execution.
* Creative standards shall be applied consistently across all projects and shall be subject to continuous refinement informed by documented review outcomes, performance analysis, and institutional learning.



**2\.2 Measurable Creative Output \& First Time\-Right Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative leadership translates into measurable, predictable, and disciplined quality outcomes.
* A minimum first\-submission approval rate of (80%) shall be maintained across formal design reviews, unless deviations are supported by documented root cause analysis and clearly defined corrective action plans.
* Review cycles shall remain within agreed revision thresholds. Recurrent rework patterns shall trigger structured evaluation, accountability review, and systemic improvement measures rather than normalization.
* All scheduled creative reviews constitute mandatory leadership obligations. Attendance shall be maintained consistently. In cases of unavoidable absence, formal delegation of documented decision authority shall be established in advance. Any missed review shall require written explanation and rescheduling within (24\) hours.
* Approvals, rejections, and required design modifications shall be communicated within agreed review timelines to prevent avoidable production delays or adverse impact on project revenue realization, forecast integrity, or client confidence.
* Review feedback and formal approval decisions shall be issued within (24\) hours of the review session unless otherwise formally justified in writing.
* Creative authority within EVA shall operate as a performance accelerator and governance safeguard, never as a constraint on disciplined production.



**2\.3 Structured Review Cadence \& Institutional Discipline** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for maintaining a defined, documented, and consistently executed creative governance rhythm across the organization.
* At minimum, one structured Creative Review session shall be led weekly, and one formal Quality Retrospective shall be conducted monthly. Each session shall produce documented minutes, clearly assigned accountability, and tracked follow\-up actions.
* Recurring quality deviations, review inefficiencies, or creative inconsistencies shall be translated into updated guidelines, strengthened enforcement protocols, or revised governance standards.
* Creative governance within EVA shall be cyclical, documented, and continuously reinforced to ensure institutional maturity and sustained quality performance.



**2\.4 Commercial Alignment \& Revenue Protection** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative decisions are aligned with approved project timelines, revenue realization schedules, forecast commitments, and overall project profitability.
* The Creative Director shall collaborate with Planning and Operations to ensure that creative timelines and review cycles are realistically reflected in revenue forecasts, milestone commitments, and execution sequencing.
* Creative refinement shall not introduce avoidable delays that negatively affect revenue progression, cash flow timing, forecast accuracy, or client confidence.
* Where creative ambition presents potential timeline, cost, or commercial exposure, such implications shall be proactively identified, formally evaluated, and resolved in coordination with project leadership and Executive Management.
* Design excellence within EVA is expected to unlock commercial value while preserving disciplined control over schedule, cost, and revenue integrity.



**2\.5 Escalation \& Risk Management Obligation** 



* Any creative, quality, review\-related, or design governance issue that may materially impact project timelines, revenue realization, client confidence, or brand reputation shall be escalated to Executive Management within (24\) hours.
* Escalation shall include a documented impact assessment, root cause analysis, and proposed mitigation strategy.
* No material creative risk shall remain unaddressed, undocumented, or without executive visibility.



**2\.6 Enforcement Authority \& Team Performance Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for enforcing compliance with approved design standards, governance frameworks, and review discipline across all design personnel.
* Where repeated non\-compliance, quality deviation, review absence, or execution inconsistency occurs, the Creative Director shall initiate structured corrective action in coordination with Executive Management and Human Resources.
* Delegation of responsibilities does not eliminate accountability for creative outcomes. Enforcement authority is inherent to the role and integral to its seniority, Sustained failure to meet defined governance cadence, revision thresholds, escalation timelines, or documented enforcement obligations shall constitute performance non\-compliance and shall be subject to formal performance review in accordance with company policy.



**2\.7 Innovation \& Strategic Creative Development** 



* The Creative Director leads structured innovation initiatives designed to enhance differentiation, strengthen quality standards, and improve execution efficiency.
* Innovation must be practical, buildable, commercially responsible, and clearly linked to brand positioning or project value.
* Creative experimentation must be governed, documented, and selectively integrated into live projects where appropriate.



**2\.8 FF\&E Library Governance \& Design Asset Control** 



* The Creative Director holds strategic ownership of EVA’s FF\&E Library and ensures that it remains curated, quality\-controlled, commercially viable, and aligned with EVA’s luxury positioning.
* All additions shall meet defined standards of originality, feasibility, execution readiness, and brand coherence.
* The FF\&E Library shall function as an active production, quality\-control, and creative governance asset supporting consistency and efficiency across projects.



**2\.9 Leadership Presence \& Accessibility** 



* The Creative Director is expected to maintain consistent on\-site leadership presence during critical review cycles, high\-visibility project phases, and production\-intensive periods.
* Leadership availability and accessibility are structural expectations of the role. Remote work arrangements shall not compromise review cadence, enforcement discipline, team accessibility, or executive responsiveness and require formal approval in accordance with company policy.
* Creative leadership within EVA requires visible authority, sustained engagement, and operational presence commensurate with the seniority of the role.



  





**Please share your CV and your portfolio to hrhead@evainteriors.ae**

title: Design Director, Brand Creative NAM
description:
**POSITION OVERVIEW**


At adidas, we never launch a product unless we consider it perfect. That standard extends beyond the products we create to how we express our brand. Global Brand Creative shapes the visual look, tone, and feel of adidas across the edges of sport and the culture it inspires, combining creative vision, design craftsmanship, and consumer insight to build a globally relevant brand.


The Design Director is a key creative leadership role responsible for developing and directing industry\-leading creative solutions across multiple consumer touchpoints. With a focus on the sport and performance sides of the business, this role translates category and brand objectives into compelling concepts, branded content, campaigns, retail experiences, digital executions, and moving image that strengthen the adidas brand from internal sell\-in through consumer\-facing sell\-out.


Working across Brand Creative, Creative Direction, Product Marketing, Product Design, Communications, Business Units, agencies, and external creative partners, the Design Director leads creative development from concept through execution. The role sets creative priorities, guides internal and external teams, and ensures work delivers against the brief while maintaining a clear, desirable, and consistent global brand expression.


IMPORTANT NOTE: This is a Limited Duration position expected to last approximately 1 year.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Creative Leadership: Lead creative development for Global Brand Creative across multiple consumer touchpoints, including 2D, retail, digital, branded content, campaigns, and moving image.


* Concept Development: Develop concepts and creative strategies that deliver against category objectives, project briefs, and the broader adidas brand vision.


* Brand Direction: Advise Communications, Business Units, Creative Direction, and other partners on the creative interpretation of strategic and project\-specific needs.


* Creative Excellence: Lead creative strategies from internal sell\-in through consumer\-facing execution to ensure consistent end\-to\-end quality and brand expression.


* Team Leadership: Set creative and assignment priorities while directing internal teams and external creative resources toward world\-class outcomes.


* Creative Community: Build a strong creative culture by developing distinctive opportunities for inspiration, learning, collaboration, and creative growth.


* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with brand, product, design, marketing, communications, and creative partners to maintain a strong consumer and brand focus.


* Creative Direction: Direct agencies, freelancers, photographers, videographers, art directors, and other creative resources to deliver cohesive and elevated creative execution.


* Creative Approval: Review and approve creative work throughout development and execution to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment with brand standards.


* Resource Management: Maximize creative impact within established budgets, timelines, and project requirements.


* Strategic Planning: Contribute to annual and long\-term Creative Direction strategies in partnership with the Senior Design Director and broader creative leadership.


* Stakeholder Communication: Present creative strategies and solutions with clarity and influence, building alignment across a range of internal and external stakeholders.


* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to strengthen creative processes, output, and ways of working, and initiate proposals or projects that advance the organization.


* Thought Leadership: Serve as a creative and brand\-building thought leader for the wider Brand Creative team, particularly across sport and performance.


* Creative Network Development: Identify emerging creative talent, partners, resources, platforms, and approaches that can elevate the quality and relevance of adidas creative work.


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Undergraduate\-level education in Design or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.


* At least 8 years of experience in the sporting goods, fashion, creative, or design industry, including experience at a managerial level.


* Minimum of 2 years of people management experience.


* Advanced experience developing creative communications and branded creative solutions.


* Proven experience across the end\-to\-end design process, including project scoping, timeline planning, design development, production, execution, and pre\-press processes.


* Expert proficiency with relevant design applications.


* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

title: HR Director
description:
Eterniti is the leading operator of vacation rentals in iconic holiday destinations, led by a passion for excellence, authentic adventures, and hospitality. With over €2 billion in assets under management, we operate 800\+ chalets, villas and apartments under 3 consumer brands: Emerald Stay (our 4\* brand), Bo House (our 5\* brand) and Verbier Exclusive (our Palace brand). Join us at a pivotal moment, with the ambition and the means to keep raising the bar.  

  

We are looking for a talented **part\-time People Director (50\-60%)** to join our dynamic team, at our Barcelona office. In this role, you will be exposed to an international group spanning various business units, where your ability to protect and nurture our culture and to excel at recruitment will be absolutely key to your success.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**  

  

**Strategic HR \& business partnering**

* Act as HR Business Partner for all companies in the group.
* Ensure HR monitoring and compliance.
* Be accountable for the OKRs process, together with our Chief of Staff.
* Run the annual employee survey and propose an annual HR plan based on the results.
* Own, monitor and act on the people dashboards to steer performance across destinations.

* Be the guardian of our group's culture.

* Participate in team members' onboardings and offboardings.

**Team management, entities \& tools**

* Manage two HR team members.
* Complete the HR integration with the Jewels (acquired companies).
* Handle key individual HR matters and HR situations that escalate.
* Be accountable for our HR tools: JazzHR and Skello.


Depending on priorities as well as your bandwidth, skills and interest, you may be involved in other projects, in line with your qualifications.

 **KEY INFORMATION**

* Employment start: as soon as possible.
* Reporting to the CEO (Maxime Friess) and COO (Laurent Lacourt).

	+ Step 1: screening call for selected candidates.

	+ Step 4: video interview with our COO.
	+ Step 5: video interview with our CEO.
	+ Step 6: references check.

**We’d love to hear from you if…**

* You have solid senior HR / People experience, ideally across several entities or countries: at least 5 years.

* You are a natural people leader who builds trust and handles confidential matters with discretion.
* You have a good working knowledge of labour and employment frameworks (France and Spain a plus).
* You are comfortable steering with data, dashboards and KPIs, and strong with digital tools.
* You speak (and write) French and English fluently; Spanish is a plus.
* You can work in the EU without visa sponsorship.

**ABOUT US**


We offer a work environment that values and empowers people while fostering personal development. Our culture is dictated by the following values :

*We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to any characteristic unrelated to their skills and experience.*

**Oh, we’ve got perks...**

* **Flexible work environment**: we have a flexible home office policy; you'll work at the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, the rest of the time, it's up to you. Feeling like working with another view? We offer 15 days yearly of remote work from wherever you’d like
* **Flexible benefits**: you’ll get a card to spend on what matters most to you: food, transport, or health insurance to optimize your net income

**THE PROJECT TO BE DEVELOPED:**


Hospital Sant Joan de Déu Barcelona (HSJD) is a private non\-profit institution with a vocation for public service since its creation in 1867\. Our hospital is dedicated to the comprehensive care of women, children and adolescents and has become one of the most important specialised centres in Europe in Paediatrics and Obstetrics, and a reference centre in healthcare, teaching and research.  

  

Our care is based on the multidisciplinary work of our professionals and is characterised by a high level of specialisation which integrates cutting\-edge technology, not only to improve the health of our patients and the community, but also to advance scientific knowledge. Through the Sant Joan de Déu Research Institute (IRSJD) and its Research Foundation (FSJD), we conduct research to find new and better treatments for maternal and foetal diseases, children and young adults’ health problems and mental health conditions. As a University of Barcelona affiliated hospital, we contribute to the training of health professionals at different stages, from undergraduate to master’s and doctoral degrees.  

  

Within HSJD, the Directorate of Research, Innovation and Learning (DRIL) manages and coordinates the activities of the hospital related to the definition of the strategic agenda of its three areas of influence, overseeing the design, promotion and implementation of strategic institutional projects within them. Additionally, the Director of DRIL is also the Scientific Director of the IRSJD.  

  

We, at the Directorate of Research, Innovation and Learning, have an innovative approach to management and are seeking a talented and motivated Project Manager to provide high\-level support to the DRIL leadership team in the implementation of our strategic agenda related specifically to Advanced Therapies and Internationalisation.  

  

You will be key in enabling the successful definition, deployment and monitoring of institutional strategic priorities, working in close collaboration with the Deputy Director of DRIL and, by extension, with the Director as well as with other hospital directorates and external partners.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


The Project Manager will work as part of the DRIL Strategic Management Office, offering:

* **Strategic project support:**


	+ Support the DRIL leadership in the structuring, planning and implementation of complex, high\-impact institutional projects in the fields of Internationalisation and Advanced Therapies.
	+ Contribute to the definition of project scopes, objectives, workplans, timelines, milestones and risk management plans.
	+ Ensure alignment of individual projects with DRIL and HSJD strategic priorities.
* **Project planning, follow\-up and reporting:**


	+ Plan, monitor and update the progress of activities using appropriate project management tools (e.g. Gantt charts, dashboards, risk and issue logs).
	+ Coordinate and prepare periodic progress reports, executive summaries and decision\-support documents for DRIL leadership and other governance bodies.
	+ Set up, maintain and improve internal reporting frameworks for large\-scale strategic projects.
* **Documentation and strategic writing:**


	+ Draft and edit high\-quality strategic documents, concept notes, internal briefing papers, presentations and position documents related to Internationalisation and Advanced Therapies.
	+ Support the preparation of materials for institutional meetings, visits, negotiations and international missions.
	+ Contribute to the preparation of governance, operational and sustainability models for new initiatives when required.
* **Stakeholder coordination and liaison:**


	+ Coordinate with other relevant hospital directorates to ensure coherent implementation of the DRIL’s strategy.
	+ Act as a point of contact for internal stakeholders involved in strategic projects (clinical leaders, research groups, management units, support services).
	+ Facilitate interactions with external partners, advisors and networks (e.g. international collaborators, consultants, advisory boards).
* **Meetings and governance support:**


	+ Organise and prepare project\-related meetings, workshops and governance committees (logistics, agendas, supporting documentation, minutes, follow\-up of action points).
	+ Participate in regular meetings with the Deputy Director, Director and DRIL team to review project status and upcoming priorities.
* **Operational and transversal tasks:**


	+ Support the identification of needs and opportunities arising from strategic projects and translate them into structured workplans.
	+ Contribute to the mapping and monitoring of strategic initiatives across HSJD, avoiding overlaps and promoting synergies.
	+ Liaise with other functional areas (legal, finance, HR, communications, etc.) for the effective implementation of strategic initiatives, including preparation of contractual documentation with external providers when needed.

**WE OFFER:**

* A full\-time contract with a trial period.
* Competitive salary ranging from €40,000 to €45,000 gross per year, depending on the candidate’s profile and experience.
* Continuous training in project management, strategic planning and other cross\-cutting professional development topics.
* An interesting, engaging and versatile position, with flexible working options (including remote work), in a dynamic, innovative and pleasant working environment.
* The opportunity to be part of an excellent, motivated, multidisciplinary and enthusiastic institution with a vocation to have a global impact on improving quality of life, with a special focus on vulnerable populations.
* SJD T\-Cuida Programme, offering initiatives and benefits to promote the physical, emotional, social and professional well\-being of our teams.
