title: Senior User Acquisition Manager
description:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort\-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

  

We are seeking a data\-driven and strategic **Senior User Acquisition Manager** to lead our Meta Ads efforts across the US region. Reporting to our Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for scaling high\-budget campaigns and optimizing complex funnels to drive enrollment for our high\-value tech programs.

  

Requirements:
  

* 4\+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition, with hands\-on account work at real budgets in expensive markets in the last year or two.
* You have experience with expensive acquisition and long, multi\-step funnels — education, B2B, fintech, high\-ticket services — in the last two to three years, not earlier in your resume.
* Comfort with narrow audiences and thin data, where judgment fills the gap statistics won't, and a clear answer to what "enough delivery to decide" means.
* You know full\-funnel economics — CAC, contribution, cohorts, lead\-to\-call, call\-to\-sale — and read CRM and BI data alongside the ad account.
* Attribution, conversion events, pixels, and tracking QA are things you've owned, not things someone did for you.
* Strong craft: A/B testing offers and creatives, and briefs a production team can run with.
* AI is already how you work — Claude, call\-analysis tools, MCP connectors, choosing the right model, catching hallucinations.
* Full professional English level.

  

Brand:
  

TripleTen  

  

What you will do:
  

* Own the budget and paid strategy for the advanced programs line — roughly $200K/month today, scaling several times over by year\-end.
* Run Meta and Google (YouTube included) as core volume channels; open LinkedIn and run experiments in Reddit and Twitter.
* Own campaign and ad\-set architecture, plus the keep\-or\-kill calls: small batches, a data threshold before deciding, weekly cadence, an honest decision log.
* Brief the content producer and judge the output on metrics — you don't write scripts or build pages, creatives, or dashboards yourself.
* Own traffic quality rather than cost per lead: read sales call transcripts, see who actually shows up, and influence target\-audience share.
* Own attribution and conversion events — pixel and event setup, separate buying infrastructure, and reconciling the ad account against CRM and BI.
* Take each new program in the line into your channels with its own funnel and targets, adding sales rather than redistributing share.

  

What we can offer you:  

  

  

* Competitive compensation.
* Full\-time remote contract with a flexible schedule.
* A close\-knit, international team of thoughtful and driven professionals.
* All software licenses and remote work tools you need to be successful in a remote working environment (Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc).

title: Senior Marketing Artist (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.  

  

**We are looking for a Senior Marketing Artist with professional experience in the video game industry to join our international team working on Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2\.**



We are looking for a strong visual artist who can take real ownership of how Space Engineers is presented across marketing channels. You will turn in\-game content, screenshots, 3D assets, and ideas into high\-quality promotional visuals, while also actively helping define what our marketing materials should look like, how they should be structured, and where the visual quality can be pushed further.



You will work across a wide range of marketing and promotional materials \- from key visuals, store assets and campaign graphics to screenshots, banners, logos, splash screens, social media content, and other 2D artwork.



This is not a purely execution\-focused role. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities independently, challenge existing approaches when needed, propose stronger visual solutions, and help establish and evolve a consistent marketing art direction for Space Engineers.



You should combine a strong artistic eye with speed, versatility, and practical execution \- someone who can explore multiple directions quickly, make sound visual decisions, work with feedback, understand the purpose behind each asset, and consistently deliver polished results.



We expect you to act as a proactive visual partner to the team, not simply wait for briefs \- spotting what is missing, proposing what should be created, and helping raise the overall standard of our marketing presentation.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely within Europe (CET \+/\- 2 hour)**



If you enjoy challenging work, seek autonomy, thrive on impact and responsibility, and want to work in a friendly environment with an inspiring international team, then come and join us!


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **6\+ years of professional experience as a Marketing Artist, 2D Artist, or Graphic Designer in the video game industry, specifically working on PC and/or console games.**
* Basic knowledge of or hands\-on experience with motion graphics and animation tools such as Adobe After Effects or similar software.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating high\-quality video game marketing and promotional artwork
* Experience creating and defining brand identities from the ground up, as well as evolving established visual identities across multiple marketing channels and asset types.
* Proven experience creating assets such as:
* + key visuals and campaign artwork
	+ promotional and store screenshots
	+ banners and social media assets
	+ splash screens
	+ logos and branding elements
	+ promotional compositions based on in\-game or 3D content
* Strong skills in Adobe Photoshop
* Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator
* Excellent understanding of composition, typography, color, lighting and visual hierarchy


**Experience creating assets for Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and other gaming platforms**


* Experience working with 3D assets or game engines to prepare promotional compositions and screenshots
* Knowledge of Blender, Unreal Engine, Unity or similar 3D tools
* Strong photo manipulation, image editing and post\-processing skills
* Ability to take existing in\-game content and transform it into compelling promotional visuals
* Ability to adapt to an established visual identity while also proposing new creative directions
* Ability to receive feedback, make changes quickly and iterate efficiently
* Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to balance quality and delivery speed
* Proactive, self\-driven mindset and ability to work independently
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.


### **Nice to have**


* Experience with motion graphics or video editing
* Familiarity with Figma
* UI/UX or in\-game UI experience
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation or technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Executive Producer
* Help define, maintain, and evolve the visual brand identity of Space Engineers across marketing materials, platforms, and campaigns.
* Create high\-quality marketing and promotional artwork for Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2
* Develop compelling visual concepts based on in\-game content, screenshots, 3D assets and existing game art
* Create a wide range of graphical materials, including:
* + key visuals
	+ promotional screenshots and beauty shots
	+ store and platform assets
	+ banners
	+ social media graphics
	+ splash screens
	+ logos and branding elements
	+ campaign visuals
	+ event and presentation materials
	+ other 2D promotional artwork
* Capture, compose and post\-process in\-game imagery to achieve strong promotional quality
* Adapt key visuals into multiple formats, resolutions and platform requirements while maintaining consistency and quality
* Collaborate with artists, marketing, production and other disciplines to understand the purpose and audience of each asset
* Explore multiple visual directions quickly before committing to final polish
* Maintain consistency with the established artistic direction and identity of Space Engineers
* Take technical and production constraints into account when proposing concepts and solutions
* Incorporate feedback efficiently and bring assets to a high\-quality final state
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, templates and production efficiency, particularly for recurring marketing assets

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Strong visual judgment** – understand what makes an image compelling, readable and effective
* **Speed, clarity and ownership** – we expect results, not status updates
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, take feedback well and be willing to discard an idea when a better one emerges
* **Purpose\-driven design** – understand what an asset needs to communicate rather than simply making it look attractive
* **Versatility** – comfortably switch between different types of marketing and 2D tasks
* **Direct communication and execution** – no politics, no hiding behind blockers, no red tape

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs
  


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.

### **Summary**

We build and buy software that touches clinical trials, patient safety, manufacturing, quality systems and commercial operations. It now ships weekly rather than yearly, is increasingly AI\-assisted, and increasingly contains AI. Our control framework was built for a slower world.  

  

This role makes secure, compliant, audit\-ready software delivery the fastest path for engineers — not a gate they route around. You will own the enterprise SDLC governance model and build much of it yourself: policy as code, automated evidence capture, pipeline controls and reference architectures.  

  

This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor leadership role. You will set enterprise direction, influence hundreds of engineers and lead through a federated community — but you will not have a large direct team, and you will spend meaningful time in repositories, pipelines and control code. Candidates seeking pure oversight or people management should not apply.
### **About the Role**

\#LI\-Hybrid  

Location: Barcelona, Spain

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the enterprise policy, standards and controls for software engineering, including source control, branching, peer review, testing, release management, environment segregation, change control, configuration and release documentation.
* Rationalise overlapping GxP, SOX, privacy, security and IT\-quality requirements into one coherent, risk\-based framework, ensuring low\-risk internal tools are not governed like regulated clinical systems.
* Retire SDLC controls that do not reduce risk and ensure tooling is implemented to securely speed up software development at Novartis at the highest scale, leveraging and creating AI tooling for the enterprise.
* Implement policy as code and controls as code, including branch protections, mandatory review, signed commits, segregation of duties, deployment approvals and immutable audit trails.
* Build automated, continuous evidence pipelines and define control telemetry including coverage, exceptions, drift, mean time to remediate and control effectiveness, with a focus on agility, automation and speed.
* Own secure\-by\-default guardrails in golden pipelines and paved\-road platforms, aligning with recognized frameworks including NIST SSDF, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62304 where applicable.
* Define controls for AI\-assisted engineering, including acceptable use of coding assistants, agentic tooling, IP and licence exposure, provenance, attribution and human accountability for review and approval.
* Define controls for AI\-containing products, including model lifecycle, dataset and model documentation, evaluation, drift monitoring, explainability, human oversight and readiness for evolving regulatory requirements.
* Use AI to reduce compliance burden through automated risk assessment drafting, control mapping, test generation, deviation triage and documentation synthesis, while serving as technical authority for inspections, audits, certifications and SDLC remediation.

description:

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.


If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**


We are seeking an Event Design Coordinator to manage the intake, production, and quality assurance of event\-related creative requests coming from a wide range of teams across the business. This is a builder\-and\-gatekeeper role: you'll work hand\-in\-hand with designers to turn varied, often fast\-turnaround requests into flawless deliverables, including booth graphics, signage, decks, digital assets, swag, and invites, while proactively spotting risks (timeline, brand, print spec, or logistical) before they become problems.


We are not looking for someone who simply routes tickets. We're looking for someone who understands both the creative process and the operational realities of live events well enough to catch a misaligned bleed line, a missing dieline, or a vendor deadline that's about to slip, and to fix it before anyone else notices.

**Responsibilities**

* **Request Intake \& Triage**
	+ Serve as the primary point of contact for event\-related creative requests coming from varied teams across Tether.
	+ Scope each request clearly: deliverable type, format (print vs. digital), quantity, deadline, dimension, venue/vendor constraints, and brand requirements.
	+ Flag conflicting timelines, unrealistic turnarounds, or missing information immediately, and propose a workable plan rather than waiting to be asked.**Design Collaboration \& Project Management**
	+ Brief designers with complete, unambiguous specs so work is right the first time.
	+ Manage multiple concurrent event workstreams across different teams and deadlines without dropping details.
	+ Track status across all active requests and proactively surface bottlenecks before they affect the event date.**Quality Assurance (Print \& Digital)**
	+ Review every designer deliverable before it goes back to the requesting team, checking brand consistency, copy accuracy, resolution, color mode (CMYK vs. RGB), bleed/trim/safe zones, file formats, and platform specs (e.g., booth panel dimensions, social crop ratios, slide aspect ratios).
	+ Catch errors that would be costly or embarrassing to fix on\-site or post\-launch (typos, wrong sizing, low\-res exports, broken links, outdated logos).
	+ Maintain a QA checklist/process that scales across event types and gets sharper over time.**Event Documentation \& Knowledge Management**
	+ Document and file all assets, briefs, and final deliverables for each event in a shared drive, using a clear, consistent structure.
	+ Organize files so the wider team can easily find past work, reuse assets, and cross\-reference specs, timelines, or creative direction from previous events.
	+ Keep a running record of vendor details, production specs, and lessons learned per event to speed up planning for future ones.**Risk \& Logistics Ownership**
	+ Anticipate what can go wrong, such as vendor lead times, print production windows, last\-minute scope changes, and shipping delays, and build buffer and contingency plans into every project timeline.
	+ Coordinate with vendors and print/production partners as needed to confirm specs and delivery windows.
	+ Keep stakeholders across requesting teams and design aligned with clear, proactive status updates rather than reactive fire drills.**Cross\-Team Partnership**
	+ Act as a trusted liaison between business requesters and the design team, protecting designers' time from ambiguous briefs while protecting requesters from missed deadlines.
	+ Continuously improve the intake and review process based on what goes wrong (or almost goes wrong) on each event.
* 5\+ years of experience in event marketing, event production, creative operations, or project management with a strong events component.
* Proven experience managing print and digital production processes; you know what a dieline is, what "safe area" means, and why RGB assets can't go straight to print.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills: demonstrated ability to manage several concurrent, cross\-functional requests with competing deadlines.
* Sharp attention to detail, comfortable being the last line of defense before a deliverable ships.
* Experience reviewing and giving actionable feedback on creative work from designers, without needing to be a designer yourself.
* A proactive, risk\-first mindset: you naturally ask "what could go wrong here?" and build a plan around the answer.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable managing stakeholders across different teams with different priorities.
* Familiarity with project management tools (Asana, Monday, or similar) and design review tools like Figma
* Experience setting up shared drive structures or asset libraries for teams.
* Fluent in English and Spanish / Italian is a plus.

**Important information for candidates**  

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third\-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double\-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting\-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.


**About Dow Jones Design \& Research:**


Our Design \& Research org brings together world\-class designers and re


searchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.


Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135\-year foundation while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our joint expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.


**About the Role:**


We're seeking a Principal Product Designer to own the design strategy for our WSJ enterprise products—professional experiences that bring The Wall Street Journal and the wider Dow Jones portfolio to the businesses and institutions that rely on our journalism to make informed decisions. In this a senior individual\-contributor role, you will set the direction for one of our growth areas and become a go\-to design expert on how Dow Jones serves enterprise and professional customers.


Enterprise customers don’t always consume content the way consumers do. Designing for them means thinking beyond the article—how a professional finds what's relevant to their work, how an organization manages access for its employees, and how our trusted journalism earns a place in the working day of decision\-makers. You'll hold enterprise design to the high bar set by our consumer products and be tightly integrated with the platforms guaranteeing these decision\-makers are empowered with WSJ \+ Dow Jones content.


This is a role with influence and scope. You'll shape strategy with senior design, product, and business leadership, resolve the tension between enterprise requirements and consumer\-grade craft, contribute to the enterprise patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across both our professional and consumer brands. You'll be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others build upon.


You will report to the SVP of Product Design within the Design \& Research organization.


**You Will:**


* Own the design strategy for our enterprise experiences. Set a coherent, multi\-year direction for how professional customers discover, read, and act on our journalism, and tie it to measurable outcomes such as seat growth, engagement, renewal, and expansion
* Own the admin experience that powers the reader experience. Design how organizations manage seats, assign content, and understand engagement across their teams
* Hold enterprise work to the Journal's standard of craft. Bring the typography, information design, and attention to detail that characterize our consumer products into a business environment, and help set the bar for what enterprise design quality means at Dow Jones
* Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your direction to senior design, product, and business leaders, and to other executives where needed, building the partnerships that move great design forward across a field of competing priorities
* Establish further patterns in our Index Design System—the components, density, navigation, and permission\-aware behavior that professional products depend on—knowing when conformity with our consumer brands serves the user and when a professional audience warrants a different approach
* Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain. Professional workflows, AI\-assisted features users must trust, and personalization that must earn its place are problems devoid of clear precedent. You'll create clarity where none exists and develop the approaches others adopt
* Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and revenue, and help teams understand which measures actually matter for a professional product
* Mentor and grow senior designers across our professional and consumer brands, shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you share

**You Have:**


* 10\+ years of product design experience, including significant time owning complex, systems\-level or platform work, with a track record of setting design direction that spans multiple products or audiences
* Depth in both enterprise and consumer design. You've built products for professional users with real workflows and real constraints, and you hold that work to the standard of the best consumer experiences. This combination is the core requirement of the role.
* Experience designing professional platforms—workspaces, dashboards, personalized feeds, admin and permissions tooling
* A portfolio that demonstrates strategic impact across multiple products or audiences: platform or design\-system contributions, cross\-team pattern\-setting, and strong end\-to\-end craft on sophisticated products
* A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, translating design strategy into business terms and building alignment across teams whose priorities compete
* Strong systems thinking and deep experience with design systems, including establishing patterns that other teams adopt and evolve
* Judgment about personalization and AI\-assisted experiences—when they genuinely help a professional user, when they diminish trust, and how to design for these scenarios
* Excellence in Figma, with the ability to set standards for design communication, specifications, and documentation across teams
* A deep command of design fundamentals and accessibility compliance standards (WCAG), with fluency in dense, information\-rich interfaces
* A track record of mentoring designers and helping raise the craft and quality of the teams around you
* Comfort operating amid ambiguity—setting direction in your domain during shifting priorities and emerging technology, and acting as the go\-to expert others turn to
* Bachelor's degree \-or\- equivalent work experience in Design, HCI, or a comparable field

**Nice to Have:**


* Experience designing B2B information services, professional intelligence, or research platforms
* Familiarity with entitlements, seat management, or permissions models at enterprise scale
* Experience shipping AI\-assisted features—summarization, recommendation, or generative content—in production products
* Background in news media, publishing, or other content\-heavy products
* Experience designing across a multi\-brand portfolio
* Experience contributing productively to a design system
* Experience partnering with external research, brand, or design agencies

description:
**Descripción de la empresa**


Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online.


Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países.


Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.


Buscamos un/a **RevOps Product Owner – AI \& Automation** para ser dueño/a de cuatro productos clave de RevOps en España como un portafolio: diagnosticar qué está roto o falta acercándote a cómo se hace el trabajo realmente, escribir las specs que justifican el caso de negocio, negociar prioridad con los equipos globales que controlan estos sistemas, y construir directamente lo que esté al alcance local — incluyendo testeo práctico y prototipado de herramientas e integraciones, aunque la implementación final sea de otro equipo.

### **Los productos de los que serás dueño/a**

* **CRM Process \& Automation** — la salud de nuestros flujos comerciales core en Salesforce/HubSpot: cumplimiento de SLA, higiene de pipeline y la automatización declarativa que mantiene los registros correctos a medida que deals y leads avanzan por el funnel — por ejemplo, que una propiedad se actualice automáticamente cuando un deal pasa a la siguiente etapa — además de la infraestructura de dashboards/reporting que los equipos usan cada día.
* **Lead Creation \& Assignment** — la lógica de enrutamiento y asignación que lleva cada lead al rep correcto en el momento correcto (construida sobre DP Lead), evolucionando hacia un modelo ponderado por capacidad y rendimiento en lugar de round\-robin plano.
* **Omni\-Channel** — la capa de WhatsApp (Kraken), llamadas, email/secuencias y agendamiento/calendario en todo el journey de sales \+ CS: qué canal, qué mensaje, en qué secuencia y cuándo — incluyendo el agendamiento y reagendamiento de demos, onboarding y reuniones de farming.
* **CRM UI/UX** — la experiencia diaria real que tienen reps y team leads dentro del CRM: comportamiento del action center, vistas, filtros y los gaps que causan tareas perdidas o workarounds mal usados.

### **Qué harás**

* **Ser dueño/a del backlog de cada producto** — diagnosticar qué está roto, falta o funciona mal en las cuatro áreas, acercándote a las personas que hacen el trabajo: shadowing, entrevistas, peticiones directas y observación propia — no suposiciones.
* **Triar lo que es tuyo** — las peticiones rutinarias de business\-as\-usual van a COE como siempre; los bottlenecks reales e issues sistémicos llegan a tu backlog para un zoom\-in adecuado.
* **Escribir las specs que justifican el caso** — convertir un problema diagnosticado en una solicitud clara y priorizada: qué está mal, qué nos cuesta, cómo sería la solución, por qué vale la pena el tiempo de ingeniería global.
* **Negociar prioridad con los equipos globales dueños de estos sistemas** — la mayoría de los cambios core en Salesforce, Kraken y otras plataformas subyacentes solo pueden hacerlos equipos fuera de RevOps España; tú eres quien construye el caso de negocio y asegura un lugar en su roadmap.
* **Testear y prototipar, de forma práctica** — validar herramientas de terceros, prototipar integraciones y entender cómo se conectan las piezas antes de pasar una spec al equipo que la construirá. Construir directamente la automatización y configuración que esté al alcance local.
* **Medir lo que lanzas o desbloqueas** — horas ahorradas, impacto en conversión/engagement y adopción, por producto. Reportar en términos de los OKRs de RevOps.
* **Hacerlo repetible** — documentar lo que funciona en playbooks o templates reutilizables.

### **Qué buscamos**

* Conocimiento profundo de las herramientas y procesos de GTM de Doctoralia España — ya lo tienes en la mayoría de estas cuatro áreas.
* Mentalidad de builder para lo que sí es construible localmente, e instinto de tester para validar herramientas e integraciones antes de que se entreguen a otro equipo. Experiencia práctica con automatización de Salesforce/HubSpot (flows, reglas de validación, triggers) es un plus importante.
* Comunicación escrita sólida — capaz de convertir un problema reportado de forma informal en una spec clara y convincente que un equipo global, con sus propias prioridades, realmente atienda.
* Cómodo/a negociando capacidad de ingeniería escasa con equipos que no te reportan, y dando seguimiento hasta que se lance.
* Fluidez en español e inglés.

### **Métricas de éxito**


La medida principal de éxito es el **throughput por operador de GTM** — cada cambio lanzado debe permitir que la gente haga más de lo que ya se espera de ella, no solo "ahorrar tiempo" de forma abstracta. Se mide como una tendencia direccional para el rol afectado tras un cambio lanzado, no como una atribución estrictamente aislada — hay demasiadas otras iniciativas en paralelo (la migración a Salesforce, la ingeniería de outbound, etc.) como para separar causas de forma limpia. Esto se acumula en **revenue (o output) por FTE de GTM**, nuestra métrica de eficiencia principal.

**Throughput por rol (principal):**

* SDRs / reps de outbound — reuniones agendadas por rep por semana/mes.
* Account Executives — oportunidades avanzadas o deals cerrados por AE.
* Especialistas de onboarding — onboardings completados por especialista en un período dado.
* Reps de CS / soporte — casos o solicitudes resueltas por rep.
* Reps de farming / cuentas — acciones de renovación o upsell completadas por rep.

**Prerrequisito (hito inicial, no asumido):** la instrumentación fiable de throughput por rol todavía no existe del todo — el reporting ha sido poco fiable en varias de estas áreas hasta hace poco. Establecer un tracking de baseline limpio para al menos tres de los cinco roles anteriores (en parte a través del trabajo de dashboards de CRM Process \& Automation) es en sí mismo un entregable del primer trimestre, no algo asumido de antemano.

### **Qué ofrecemos**

* Ownership total de cuatro productos reales y ya diagnosticados — no ejecución de tareas, sino responsabilidad genuina de producto de principio a fin.
* Espacio para profundizar de forma práctica donde importa — testear, prototipar y conectar herramientas, no solo escribir specs.
* Un camino hacia un conocimiento más profundo de cómo está construido y configurado Salesforce internamente, más allá de lo que tendrías quedándote solo en el lado local/HubSpot.
* Colaboración directa con el Head of Revenue Operations y, una vez cubierta, con el/la futuro/a RevOps Product Manager – AI Solutions.
* Modelo de trabajo híbrido.

**Información adicional**


Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.


Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.


Seguro médico privado.


Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.


Clases de idiomas gratuitas.


Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.


Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

* Partner with Sales and Marketing on GTM strategy and enablement

* Protect UX so complex workflows stay intuitive within NetSuite

* AI\-native: builds with AI daily and has shipped AI/agentic features to production
* 5\+ years in Product Management within Fintech, ERP, or B2B SaaS, with direct P2P/AP/procurement ownership

* Track record taking roadmaps from discovery to launch
* Experience owning a live, at\-scale product — balancing new work against defects, escalations, and tech debt
* Strong Agile/Scrum skills and familiarity with tools like Jira or Productboard
* Proven success in fully remote, async, globally distributed teams
* Excellent communicator, able to translate compliance logic into simple software


**Preferred**


* Experience with Oracle NetSuite or a comparable native ERP platform
* Familiarity with P2P/spend tools (Coupa, Ariba, Bill.com, Tipalti, AvidXchange, Ramp) and OCR/document capture
* Understanding of multi\-jurisdictional tax logic (VAT/GST/Sales Tax)
* Finance/accounting/procurement certification (CPA, ACCA, CIMA, CPIM, etc.)
* Experience scaling products in high\-growth (Series C–D) environments

**Benefits**



At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high\-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it's the standard. We're looking for self\-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.



We ditch micro\-management for high\-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers

Zone \& Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.

Employment with Zone is **"At\-Will"**, meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. title: Senior UX Designer (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.


**We are looking for a Senior UX Designer with professional experience in the video game industry to join our international team working across Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2\.**



Space Engineers is a complex sandbox game built around engineering, construction, exploration, survival, and player creativity. That complexity is part of what makes the game unique \- but it also creates significant UX challenges.



We are looking for someone who can take real ownership of how players interact with our systems, identify usability problems, and turn complex mechanics and information into clear and intuitive player experiences.



Because we are a relatively small team, we are looking for a hands\-on and versatile UX Designer who can contribute beyond UX theory, wireframes, and documentation. Strong UX expertise is the foundation of the role, but ideally you also bring visual/UI design skills or, alternatively, experience with technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation. Visual/UI design is particularly valuable for us given the current composition of the team.



You will work closely with Game Design, Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, helping shape both existing and new features from early concepts through to implementation.



We expect you to act as a proactive UX partner \- identify friction, challenge existing solutions when needed, test assumptions, and help us establish stronger UX principles across both games.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely within Europe (CET \+/\- 2 hours).**



If you enjoy challenging work, autonomy, impact, and responsibility, come and join us

  


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **5\+ years of professional experience as a UX Designer, Game UX Designer, or similar role, with significant experience working in the video game industry on PC and/or console games**
* Proven experience designing UX for shipped video games, ideally across multiple features or systems
* Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating your UX process, including problem definition, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, iteration, and final solutions
* Hands\-on approach to UX design, **with experience in at least one adjacent discipline that allows you to contribute beyond UX documentation – ideally UI/visual design, or alternatively technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation**
* Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, user flows, usability principles, navigation systems, and information hierarchy
* Experience working on sandbox, simulation, strategy, management, or other systems\-heavy games
* Strong experience designing UX for complex and interconnected game systems, such as inventories, building systems, crafting, progression, control schemes, or similar mechanics
* Ability to make complex mechanics and information understandable and intuitive without removing their depth
* Strong wireframing and prototyping skills using Figma or equivalent tools
* Experience creating and evolving UX/UI design systems, interaction patterns, and reusable component libraries
* Experience designing UX for both mouse \& keyboard and controller\-based interaction
* Experience validating UX solutions through usability testing, playtesting, player research, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, or similar methods
* Knowledge of accessibility principles in game UX
* Strong design judgment – able to identify usability problems and their root causes, propose practical solutions, and explain design decisions using player needs, evidence, and clear reasoning
* Ability to work effectively with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, understand technical and production constraints, and incorporate them into UX solutions
* Proactive and self\-driven, with the ability to work independently, iterate quickly, receive feedback, and adapt solutions when needed
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.


**Nice to have**
----------------


* Strong visual/UI design skills, including typography, layout, iconography, visual hierarchy, and the ability to take UX concepts through to polished, production\-ready interface designs
* Experience creating or adapting UI assets and working within an established visual language or art direction
* Experience implementing or integrating UI directly in a game engine or proprietary engine
* Experience combining UX design with UI/visual design and/or technical implementation within the same role
* Experience working on live games and improving established systems without disrupting existing player workflows or expectations
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation, engineering, or other technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Production Director and be part of a Game design team
* Take ownership of UX across **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**, covering both existing systems and new features
* Identify player friction and usability problems, understand their root causes, and propose practical improvements
* Work with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA from the early stages of feature development to shape solutions that balance player needs, game design intent, visual clarity, technical feasibility, and production constraints
* Translate complex mechanics, systems, and requirements into clear and intuitive player experiences


**Define and improve:**


* + player flows and navigation
	+ information architecture and interaction patterns
	+ menus, HUD, and in\-game interactions
	+ system feedback
	+ onboarding and discoverability
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and UX specifications, exploring and validating solutions early before significant development time is invested
* Take solutions beyond UX documentation where appropriate to your skill set – whether through polished UI/visual design, high\-fidelity prototyping, or contributing to UI integration and implementation
* Use playtesting, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, and other available evidence to validate solutions and guide iteration
* Follow UX solutions through development, review implementation, and help ensure the intended player experience is preserved in the final product
* Establish and evolve consistent UX principles, interaction patterns, and design systems across both games
* Clearly communicate UX problems, design decisions, and trade\-offs to stakeholders using evidence, player needs, and clear reasoning
* Balance usability with game depth, technical limitations, development cost, existing player expectations, and long\-term maintainability
* Help improve UX practices across the wider development team and ensure UX is considered throughout development rather than treated as a final review step

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Player\-first thinking without oversimplification** – make complex systems understandable while preserving the depth that makes Space Engineers unique
* **Hands\-on, versatile design** – UX should not stop at diagrams or recommendations; be comfortable turning ideas into tangible solutions and contributing beyond a narrowly defined UX role when needed
* **Problem solving over screen production** – understand the underlying player problem before designing the interface
* **Systems thinking** – understand how individual interactions connect to the broader player experience
* **Strong judgment and prioritisation** – recognise where UX problems have the greatest impact, understand trade\-offs, and focus effort where it matters most
* **Clarity over cleverness** – favour solutions that players can understand naturally, without unnecessary complexity
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, test assumptions, take feedback well, and change direction when a better solution emerges
* **Ownership and proactivity** – do not wait for perfectly defined UX problems; identify what needs to be solved and help drive it forward
* **Evidence over opinion** – use player behaviour, usability principles, testing, and clear reasoning rather than personal preference
* **Clear and direct communication** – explain UX problems, decisions, and trade\-offs clearly and challenge ideas constructively

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)

title: Lead UI/UX Designer - Mobile Casual F2P Games
description:
The Opportunity
UserWise is looking for an experienced **Lead UI/UX Designer** to own the UI/UX discipline for a a mobile Free\-to\-Play game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.


This is a **hands\-on leadership role** for someone who can translate game and product designs into clear flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes before significant art or engineering work begins. You will stay ahead of production, validate interactions early, identify usability problems before they become expensive production problems, and follow features through implementation to ensure the intended player experience survives into the final game.


You will also mentor and work alongside an existing UI/UX Designer, helping establish stronger UX processes, patterns, and quality standards across the project.


This is not a management\-only role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable getting directly into the work — mapping flows, wireframing screens, building prototypes, iterating on UI, reviewing builds, and solving problems alongside Game Design, Art, Product, Engineering, and Production.


What You’ll Do* Own the overall **UX quality and UI/UX discipline** across the game.
* Translate game and product concepts into clear user journeys, flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes.
* Stay ahead of production by resolving major interaction and usability questions before features move into Art and Engineering.
* Rapidly prototype and compare UX solutions before committing significant production time.
* Own information architecture, navigation, screen hierarchy, interaction patterns, usability, and player comprehension.
* Design intuitive experiences for gameplay, progression, onboarding, rewards, LiveOps, social features, and monetization.
* Proactively identify UX problems through design reviews, prototypes, and playable builds.
* Follow features through implementation and work with Engineering to preserve design intent.
* Improve the **Game Design**  **UX**  **Art**  **Engineering** workflow so features move through production with clearer intent and fewer late\-stage redesigns.
* Establish reusable UX patterns, UI components, interaction standards, and documentation.
* Mentor and work in parallel with another UI/UX Designer while remaining directly involved in execution.
* Partner closely with the Art Director to define and evolve the visual language of the UI, translating the game’s overall art direction into a cohesive, scalable interface system.

  

**Requirements**  

  

What We’re Looking For* Senior or Lead\-level experience designing UI/UX for shipped games.
* Strong shipped experience with **mobile Free\-to\-Play games**, ideally casual or mass\-market titles.
* A portfolio demonstrating both **UX thinking and finished game experiences**, not just polished UI screens.
* Strong ability to turn complex game systems into simple, intuitive player experiences.
* Excellent understanding of mobile interaction design, information architecture, hierarchy, readability, feedback, and usability.
* Experience designing F2P systems such as progression, rewards, FTUE, events, LiveOps, and monetization.
* Strong wireframing and interactive prototyping skills.
* Strong proficiency with **Figma** or equivalent modern product\-design tools.
* Strong UI design fundamentals and the ability to take work beyond low\-fidelity UX when needed.
* Strong product judgment and a proactive approach to identifying and solving experience problems.
* Experience mentoring or providing design direction to other UI/UX Designers.
* Experience collaborating closely with Game Designers, Artists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Producers throughout feature development.
* Familiarity with Unity\-based game production is highly valuable.
* Comfort using AI\-assisted or rapid\-prototyping tools to explore and validate design solutions faster is a plus.


Portfolio
A strong portfolio is essential for this role.


We are particularly interested in examples that demonstrate:

* Shipped mobile and F2P game experiences
* User flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes
* Evolution from early UX concepts to final shipped UI
* Gameplay, onboarding, progression, rewards, LiveOps, or monetization UX
* Examples where you simplified a complex feature or solved a meaningful usability problem
* Your individual contribution versus the work of the broader team


Case studies showing **how you arrived at a solution** are especially valuable. We want to understand the problem, the alternatives you explored, the decisions you made, and how the experience evolved through implementation.

 **Benefits**  

  

Why Join UserWise* Own the UX of a flagship mobile game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.
* Have significant influence over the product while it is still actively being shaped.
* Work in a lean team where UI/UX is central to the game experience rather than a downstream production function.
* Establish the UX processes, standards, and design systems that guide the project.
* Experiment with rapid prototyping and AI\-assisted workflows to increase iteration speed and design quality.
* 100% remote, flexible work with a small, experienced team.


What We Offer* Market\-competitive compensation
* Paid Time Off
* Performance Bonus
* Annual Performance Reviews

description:
### **Introduction to the Team \& Role**



What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?

GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go\-to\-market faster, smarter and more effective.

We already have a high\-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.

You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.

title: Digital Product Owner – EMR & API Integration
description:
*At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a baby.*

###### **We are looking for a** **Digital Product Owner – EMR \& API Integration** **to join our Customer Success Development team.**


Help shape how fertility clinics connect their EMR systems with Vitrolife's products and services—and make every day work simpler for the people supporting patients on their journey to parenthood.


Our vision is to create a connected, scalable integration experience that makes clinic onboarding and integration quick and easy, improves workflows in IVF clinics and within Vitrolife, and makes it simpler for clinics to work with Vitrolife products and services, including genetic testing, time\-lapse systems, and electronic witnessing solutions.


The product is at an early stage, with an initial MVP. This is a hands\-on building role in which you will help develop the product into a scalable offering and establish effective ways of working as the domain grows. Strong technical product judgment will be especially valuable in the near term as you work closely with the Tech Lead, developers, and external technical teams. As the product develops, the role will increasingly focus on business value, adoption, and expansion.

##### **Main Purpose**


You own product direction, scope, priorities, and outcomes, aligned with business strategy. You are accountable for value realization, return on investment (ROI), risk management, and long\-term product health. The Tech Lead owns architecture and technical direction.


You will work directly with fertility clinics to understand their workflows and needs. Your other primary external collaborators are EMR providers, with occasional contact with customers' integration partners. Internally, Business Process Owners are your key collaborators for process and data requirements.


Location: Valencia \| 4\+1 remote work policy \| Full\-time


Reports to: Head of Customer Care Center of Excellence (CoE).


Please note that only CVs submitted in English will be reviewed.

##### **Key****Responsibilities**

**Product Direction \& Delivery**  

Own and communicate the vision, roadmap, backlog, and release priorities. Prioritize by value, reuse, risk, dependencies, feasibility, and total cost of ownership. Define requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria; accept delivered functionality and validate outcomes with Business Process Owners and subject matter experts.

**Customer \& Internal Process Requirements**  

Talk directly with clinics to understand and validate what they need to send, receive, and retrieve through their EMRs. With Business Process Owners, define the data, quality, completeness, and timing needed for efficient internal processes.

**API \& EMR Provider Experience**  

Make integrations straightforward to implement and support, covering API documentation, onboarding, testing, production readiness, monitoring, support, versioning, and backward compatibility. Balance provider\-specific needs with consistent, scalable API capabilities.

**Technical \& Cross\-Domain Collaboration**  

Work with the Tech Lead, developers, and external technical teams on product options and trade\-offs; provide technically credible feedback on reliability, security, privacy, data flows, and integration design. Align shared capabilities and dependencies with other Digital Product Owners, the Enterprise Architect, and enabling teams; resolve or escalate cross\-domain conflicts.

**Adoption \& Continuous Improvement**  

Coordinate rollout and operational readiness with EMR providers, Customer Success, and internal teams. Use feedback and KPIs to improve adoption, data quality, integration reliability, operational efficiency, and realized business value.  

  

**What You Need to Succeed**


Predictable EMR onboarding, growing adoption of reusable integrations, and reliable data flows that reduce manual work and improve customer and internal processes.

##### **Core Requirements**

* Proven experience personally building and scaling a B2B API or integration product from MVP or first production launch to adoption across multiple customers or systems.
* 5\+ years in product ownership or product management, combining product strategy with hands\-on prioritization and delivery in agile or product\-oriented environments.
* Strong technical product experience from software, APIs, or integrations, including the ability to give constructive feedback, discuss solution options with internal developers and external technical teams, and translate clinic workflows and internal process needs into API requirements.
* Technical fluency in APIs, data contracts, authentication, versioning, backward compatibility, and reliability. Able to read API documentation, follow data flows, and make technically credible product trade\-offs with the Tech Lead and developers; coding is not required.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills, including collaboration with Business Process Owners, aligning expectations, and saying no to misaligned or low\-value requests.
* Fluent English, written and verbal.
##### **Additional Qualification**

* EMR/EHR, healthcare, or laboratory\-system experience, and familiarity with standards such as FHIR or HL7\.
* Previous experience as a software or integration developer, solution architect, technical business analyst, or implementation consultant is beneficial but not required.

##### **What We Offer**

* Meaningful product ownership in an international healthcare company, working closely with business, IT, and product colleagues.
* Competitive compensation, medical insurance, and flexible benefits.
* Discounts on our employee platform and gym memberships.

 **Please submit your CV in English. Interviews will be conducted in English.**

###### ***The employee will be based in Valencia (Parque Tecnológico de Paterna)***

**Vitrolife Group is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities.**

*Vitrolife Group is a global provider of medical devices and genetic services. Based on science and advanced research capabilities, we develop services and products for personalised genetic information and medical device products. We support our customers by improving their clinical practice for the patient's outcome of a fertility treatment.*

*We are currently approximately 1 100 colleagues worldwide, with headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. Vitrolife Group's products and services are available in more than 110 countries through our own presence in 30 countries and a network of distributors. Vitrolife Group is a sustainable market leader and aims to be the preferred partner for IVF\-clinics by providing superior products and services with the vision of fulfilling the dream of having a baby. The Vitrolife share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.*

title: Global Health Economics and Outcomes research (HEOR) Lead
description:

title: Senior Coordinator, PASS Housing
description:
About CEA CAPA

  

At CEA CAPA, we believe studying and interning abroad is a transformative experience. By immersing themselves in new cultures, our students gain valuable skills and perspectives that shape their futures.

  

We’re proud to be a recognized sector leader, known for our delivery of impactful academic, professional and cultural experiences. This is achieved through our dedicated global team who provide comprehensive guidance, instruction, support and resources to maximize the benefit of our students’ time abroad.

  

A sense of belonging is central to CEA CAPA’s mission. We foster a work environment that values diversity and is free from bias. Our hiring practices are based on professional qualifications, skills and competence.

  

With a footprint that spans 53 cities in 20 countries across Europe, Latin America and Australia our 450 strong global workforce deliver exceptional cultural experiences abroad to over 7,000 students per annum.

  

Position Summary  

The Senior Coordinator, Housing and Student Services plays a key operational role in the delivery of student housing and student services in Madrid. The role combines hands\-on student support with responsibility for coordinating the day\-to\-day work of the Housing team, organizing workflows and priorities, overseeing housing operations, and supporting the PASS Director with budget management and semester planning. The Senior Coordinator serves as a senior point of reference for housing\-related matters, helps ensure consistent service standards, and coordinates effectively with students, colleagues, landlords, residences, vendors, and other external partners.
The role supports students throughout their programs, from logistics to cultural integration, ensuring a seamless and enriching experience. It also involves administrative tasks such as managing program materials and handling student accommodation issues.  

Responsibilities  

* Serve as a senior point of contact for students, providing guidance, information, resources, and support throughout their program.
* Coordinate the day\-to\-day work of the Housing team, organizing workloads, priorities, schedules, coverage, and operational deadlines.
* Support, guide, and coordinate team members, ensuring clear allocation of responsibilities, effective communication, and consistent service delivery.
* Oversee core student housing operations, including placements, arrivals, departures, room changes, maintenance, inspections, inventories, and accommodation\-related incidents.
* Coordinate housing readiness before each semester, ensuring apartments and other accommodation options meet operational and student\-service requirements.
* Manage relationships and day\-to\-day coordination with landlords, residences, maintenance providers, cleaning services, and other housing vendors.
* Monitor housing issues and escalations, identify appropriate solutions, and escalate significant operational, contractual, financial, or student welfare concerns to the PASS Director as required.
* Support the Center Director / PASS Director in managing the Housing budget, monitoring expenditure, reviewing invoices and costs, and maintaining accurate financial records.
* Prepare and maintain semester housing budget forecasts, anticipated occupancy and capacity needs, and projected operational expenses, identifying potential variances and cost pressures in advance.
* Track housing capacity, availability, and utilization to support semester planning and informed accommodation decisions.

* Identify opportunities to improve housing processes, service quality, operational efficiency, vendor performance, and cost effectiveness.
* Maintain accurate housing and student records in Salesforce and other relevant systems, ensuring information is current and appropriately documented.
* Coordinate and support student arrivals, orientations, departures, activities, and other PASS operations as required.
* Collaborate closely with Student Services, Academics, Health \& Safety, Custom Programs, Global Operations, and other internal teams to ensure coordinated student support.
* Participate in regular staff and planning meetings and provide operational updates, risks, budget information, and recommendations to the PASS Director.
* Support the onboarding, training, and day\-to\-day development of Housing team members and contribute to maintaining clear procedures and shared working standards.
* Be part of the emergency phone rotation and support the response to urgent student and housing situations in accordance with CEA CAPA procedures.
* Provide operational coverage and decision\-making support in the Housing area when required, particularly during peak periods, arrivals, departures, and staff absences.

  

Person Specification* Resilient and adaptable.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate people, competing priorities, schedules, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated leadership and team coordination skills, with the ability to guide colleagues and promote accountability and collaboration.
* Strong budget management, financial tracking, forecasting, and cost\-control skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong relationship\-management and negotiation skills with internal and external stakeholders.
* Able to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and contribute effectively to a wider team.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and a practical, flexible, and creative approach to operational challenges.
* High attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records and follow through on complex operational matters.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and other digital tools.
  

Qualifications and Experience* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Fluency in English and Spanish.
* Significant experience working with students, particularly international students.
* Demonstrated experience in student housing, accommodation operations, property coordination, or a closely related area.
* Experience coordinating or supervising team members, workflows, or operational projects.
* Experience managing budgets, monitoring expenditure, and preparing forecasts or financial projections.
* Experience working with external vendors, landlords, service providers, and other operational partners.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse identities and backgrounds.
* Experience living or working abroad, with strong knowledge of the local culture, housing environment, business practices, and academic context.
* Knowledge of the U.S. higher education system is desirable.
* Authorization to work in the location of the role.
  

NB. This role profile is intended to provide an overview of the key responsibilities and qualifications for the position. It is not exhaustive, and the role holder may be required to perform additional tasks and duties as directed by leadership. Consequently, CEA CAPA reserves the right to modify this role profile at any time in accordance with evolving business needs and local legislation.

title: Sr. Manager, Global Packaging
description:

At NextPower, we lead the energy transition, providing intelligent solar trackers, power conversion, and control software solutions, together with strategic services that help our customers capture the full value of their solar power plants.  



  

As a company driving the clean energy transition, sustainability is central to our business and operations. Our worldwide teams are creative, collaborative and passionate problem\-solvers, driven by our mission to provide smarter energy solutions and support the transition to a more sustainable future.  



  

We are looking for a **Sr. Manager, Global Packaging Engineering** , based in **Madrid, Spain** , reporting to the **Sr. Director, Logistics Operations \& Packaging** .  



  

This role will lead our **Global Packaging Engineering function** , defining and implementing packaging strategy, standards and technical solutions across our global product portfolio. We are looking for someone who combines **strong technical packaging expertise with proven people leadership** and who is comfortable working both strategically and hands\-on.  



  

The position will work globally across Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, and our supplier network, with a particular focus on NPI, returnable packaging, standardization, sustainability, cost optimization, **and product protection** .  



  

### **What you will do**

* Develop and own the **Global Packaging Engineering strategy** , aligned with business priorities and focused on standardization, quality, sustainability, safety and cost optimization.
* Lead, develop and grow the **global Packaging Engineering team** , including capability development, resource allocation, performance management and common ways of working across regions.
* Represent Packaging Engineering in **NPI and new product development** , ensuring packaging requirements are considered from the early design stages through industrialization and launch.
* Lead the development and implementation of **returnable packaging programs** , including technical solutions, business cases, supplier implementation and operational deployment.
* Establish and maintain global **packaging standards, specifications, guidelines and validation requirements** across products, suppliers and regions.
* Drive packaging solutions for the full NextPower portfolio, including existing products, **new technologies and business verticals** , ensuring scalability as the company continues to grow.
* Work closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders to develop and validate packaging solutions, challenging existing designs and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Drive **value engineering and cost\-reduction initiatives** , considering not only packaging cost but also container utilization, transportation, handling, warehousing, product damage and total landed cost.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics and Operations to ensure packaging solutions meet technical, operational and customer requirements.

* Proficiency in supply chain, material origins, traceability laws, certification standards and traceability (such as GRS, GOTS, CCS, OCS, FSC, PEFC, etc.).

* Well\-organized, structured mind and good team player.
* Excellent fluency in English and Spanish. French is a plus.
* C\-level presentation skills.
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

* Outstanding attention to details.
* Motivated by a challenging brief and shows a can\-do attitude.

* Strong sense of international fashion and trends.
* A real passion for LOEWE and our collections.

* Proactive and positive approach.

* Fluency in English is essential. Spanish and any other language is a plus.
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------
