Founded in Barcelona in 2017, Innovamat provides schools with a comprehensive, evidence\-based mathematics program spanning from Early Childhood Education through Secondary School, developed together with leading experts in mathematics didactics, cognition, and neuroscience.


The program integrates curriculum, teacher training, assessment, and intervention into a single coherent system. Present in 9 countries and serving more than 720,000 students, Innovamat is one of the few organizations in the sector with efficacy data independently validated by external research institutions. It is also the first non\-U.S. organization to successfully complete the California State Board of Education's adoption process for a core mathematics curriculum.

##### **About the Role and Why It’s Special**

Innovamat is turning 10\. We've gotten here with 350 people across 9 countries and a stable financial position. That puts us in a position **to bet on and invest in the next phase of our People function and bring it to the highest level of importance in the company.** This isn't a vacancy to cover an operational need: it's a strategic decision about how we want Innovamat to grow in its next decade.


Today there is a solid, committed People team, distributed across HQ, EU, LATAM, and the United States, but without a global system that unifies levels, compensation architecture, performance evaluation, onboarding, and management training. The person joining as Global Head of People will be **the first person responsible for building that system at a global scale, and will do so at the moment of greatest growth in our history.**


They will report directly to the CEO, building the organization's people direction, and will collaborate directly with the rest of the leadership team. They will also be responsible for our current globally\-scoped People team, made up of both the Headquarters team and the teams across the different geographies where we operate.


We are not looking for someone who wants to focus on administrative processes, nor someone who prefers to design and delegate. **We are looking for someone who knows how to move between strategy and execution**: someone who understands the day\-to\-day of the business in depth and wants to make People a strategic function and key ally to the business.


Our philosophy is clear: we believe in empowering managers as the ultimate owners of their teams' people. We want to find the balance between process and bureaucracy and move at high speed. This person will play a key role in establishing the frameworks and structure needed so that speed doesn't compromise quality, so we continue to care for our talent and culture, and so we maintain our bar of excellence as we grow the team.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

At this pivotal moment for Innovamat, we're looking for someone who will take on this challenge as their own and be able to mobilize and make an impact across the entire organization.

**People Strategy, Architecture \& Organization**

* Design the first levels and compensation bands architecture for all 9 countries.
* Define which metrics we monitor and with which tools, consistently.
* Define the framework for the benefits architecture by country, setting common principles at a global level, with the flexibility needed to adapt to each market.
* Redesign the performance evaluation system, with two annual cycles and real calibration across departments and geographies.
* Implement an executive people analytics dashboard for the CEO and the Leadership Team with key metrics.
* Maintain the balance between organizational growth and as flat a structure as possible, establishing the minimum bureaucracy needed at each stage.
* Track spans, layers, and revenue per employee as core metrics.
* Identify management needs before they become a problem.

**People Business Partnering \& Development**

* Lead the global team of People BPs (HQ, Spain, Italy, LATAM, US).
* Build the management training program.
* Implement a systematic, measured onboarding process across all countries.
* Define a system to identify top performers and cases of underperformance.
* Develop the employer brand and our own talent pipeline at a global level.

**Talent Acquisition**

* Lead the global Talent team (HQ, Spain, Italy, LATAM, US).
* Own the hiring standard, consistently evaluating each candidate's purpose, learning ability, and reliability, with a unified criteria across countries.
* Define and track hiring metrics
* Prioritize closing critical positions in product, artificial intelligence, and the United States market.

**People Operations, Processes \& Employee Support**

* Define the company's people rhythm: what cycles exist, when, and who runs them, at a global level.
* Maintain a small number of processes, with a high/flawless execution standard across all geographies.
* Ensure consistency and internal communication across our three markets (HQ, Spain, Italy, LATAM, and the United States) with three different languages in use.
* Define and roll out the method for communicating complex organizational decisions.

**Partnering with the Leadership Team**


This is the most valuable part of the role and the one that takes the longest to develop. It will unfold in the following phases:

* **Phase 1:** Contribute, together with the CEO, to designing the Leadership Team's performance evaluation framework, as a specific application of the company's general evaluation system.
* **Phase 2:** Develop the Leadership Team's evaluation cycles, in collaboration with the CEO, with increasing autonomy as the cycles mature.
* **Phase 3:** Act as People Business Partner to the Leadership Team, responsible for providing data\-driven assessments on the performance and continuity of its members.

##### **What We are Looking For**

**Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of work experience building or leading people systems, teams, or processes from scratch.
* 4\+ years of experience leading people or project teams with real business accountability (P\&L, budget, or quota). A background in HR is strongly preferred, but not required.
* Experience operating in multi\-country environments, with teams and stakeholders across different geographies and time zones.
* The following will be positively valued:


	+ Experience in top\-tier strategy consulting, followed by an operational stage.
	+ Prior experience in international organizations or in expanding markets, particularly the United States.
	+ Experience in compensation, leveling, or performance evaluation systems, ideally across several countries.

**Skills**

* Analytical rigor and a data\-driven approach to decision\-making.
* Ability to dive into detail, hold a high execution standard, and connect teams to the company's vision.
* Ability to operate under pressure, at a fast pace of growth, and in an environment of ambiguity and quick decision\-making.
* Excellent communication skills at all levels of the organization.
* Interest and passion for developing high\-performing teams, leadership, and corporate culture to achieve ambitious goals.
* An interest in the education sector and genuine motivation and commitment to the project will be positively valued.
* Fluency in English and Spanish is required. Catalan is a plus.

##### **What can you expect from us?**


Our culture and values defines who we are and how we work. We believe that how we do things matters just as much as what we do. We know this isn’t the right place for everyone —and that’s okay. Here’s what you can expect when joining our team:

* **We aim high:** We set ambitious goals and work to high standards. We’re driven by the conviction that improving education is a game changer —and we’re here to take it on with determination and passion. Here, you’ll be able to grow as much as you want!
* **We are owners:** From day one, you’ll take real responsibility and have real impact. We make thoughtful decisions, take initiative, and turn ideas into action —you’ll feel trusted to lead projects, make decisions, and watch your ideas come to life.
* **We move fast:** We work in a dynamic, ever\-evolving environment where speed and adaptability make the difference. Things move fast —and so do we. You’ll feel the pace, the energy, and the thrill of learning and acting quickly to make things happen.
* **We are eager to learn:** Our team is made up of curious, motivated people who challenge themselves —and each other— to grow. We value those who approach every challenge as a learning opportunity and bring a positive, solution\-oriented mindset, because here, every day is a chance to learn something new and share it with others.
* **We are humble:** We’re guided by feedback and collaboration. We listen actively, learn from one another, and value ideas for their impact —not for who they come from. You’ll find teammates who boost you up, challenge you kindly, and celebrate wins as a team.
* **We enjoy the ride:** Our impact depends on the people who make it possible. We’re an international, passionate team that thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-energy environment where intensity and purpose go hand in hand. We believe that a strong culture of trust, flexibility, and care is what makes our impact sustainable. We take care of our people so they can take care of our mission —offering flexible working hours, time off during the Christmas break, and flexible compensation options. And of course, we make space to reconnect and recharge through team\-building days that bring us closer and remind us why we do what we do.


If you think you are that person we are looking for **we would love to meet you!**

**IT STARTS HERE**

Our mission is to contribute to help more **people and businesses prosper** . We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.


**The Economic Research Area** is institutionally responsible for preparing and coordinating all macroeconomic forecasts for Santander Bank for the Group’s main forums and Committees. It also conducts macroeconomic and macro\-financial analysis of the Group’s key countries and business units, while advising Senior Management on the economic scenarios relevant to strategic decision\-making


Within the department, the Latin America area coordinates the macroeconomic analysis of the countries where Santander has a presence in the region and integrates local perspectives into a coherent regional view connected to the Group’s global economic outlook. It also participates in the design and preparation of the macroeconomic scenarios used in planning processes and stress\-testing exercises, in close collaboration with the local Economic Research teams and the relevant corporate areas.


**THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE**

**The Economic Research Area** is looking for a **Head of Economic Analysis for Latin America** based out of **Madrid** .


We are looking for a senior or semi\-senior macroeconomist with coordination capabilities, sound analytical judgment and an independent, well\-founded economic view, capable of integrating perspectives from different countries and contributing to the development of the regional view of Latin America and its connection to the Group’s global economic outlook. The candidate should combine strong hard skills (economic analysis, proficiency in econometric software and, preferably, programming) with sound soft skills (teamwork, negotiation and public speaking).


We’re **shaping the way we work** through innovation, cutting\-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:


* Coordinate the macroeconomic analysis of Latin America, integrating the perspectives of local economic teams into a coherent and consistent regional view connected to the Group’s global economic outlook.
* Develop and update an independent, well\-founded economic view of Latin America, identifying the region’s main trends, risks and opportunities.
* Participate in the design, preparation and monitoring of the macroeconomic scenarios used in the Group’s planning, budgeting and stress\-testing processes, in collaboration with the local Economic Research teams and contributing independent judgment to the definition and challenge of the scenarios.
* Analyze economic, financial and political developments in the region’s main countries, assessing their implications for Santander.
* Ensure the consistency and quality of the economic forecasts, scenarios and narratives developed for the different Latin American countries, challenging their assumptions when necessary.
* Act as a coordination point between the region’s Economic Research teams and the relevant corporate areas, facilitating the integration of the regional and global views.
* Prepare reports, presentations and briefings to support the head of the area in interactions with senior management and corporate committees, as well as the planning and risk areas, translating complex economic issues into clear and relevant messages.
* Contribute to cross\-functional projects related to planning, risk management and macroeconomic analysis, providing the Latin American economic perspective.
* Drive continuous improvement in the methodologies, tools and processes used for economic analysis and scenario development.
* Promote the responsible and efficient use of artificial intelligence, automation and data analysis tools to enhance productivity and the quality of analytical work.
* Contribute to the development of other team members through knowledge transfer, guidance and review of their work.
* Represent Banco Santander at various forums and events on Latin America.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organization. We’re **enabling teams to go beyond** by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.


The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


**Professional Experience**

* Solid experience in macroeconomic analysis, economic forecasting, scenario design and coordination, or macro\-financial risk assessment. (Required)
* Experience in preparing, challenging and defending macroeconomic forecasts and economic scenarios. (Required)
* Experience coordinating projects or work involving multiple stakeholders, teams and geographies. (Required)
* Experience preferably gained in economic research departments, financial institutions, central banks, international organizations, research centers or universities. (Required)
* Knowledge of Latin American economies and the main risks and trends affecting the region. (Preferred)

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Economics or related disciplines. (Required)
* Postgraduate education, Master’s degree or PhD in Economics, Econometrics, Finance, Statistics or related fields. (Preferred)

**Languages**

* High level of spoken and written Spanish and English. (Required)
* Knowledge of Portuguese. (Preferred)

**Hard Skills**

* Strong knowledge of macroeconomics, international economics and emerging markets. (Required)
* Strong knowledge of econometrics and quantitative methods applied to forecasting, modeling and macroeconomic analysis. (Required)
* Experience in applied economic analysis, forecasting and scenario development. (Required)
* Proficiency in programming and data analysis tools such as Python, R, Matlab or Stata. (Preferred)
* Familiarity with generative artificial intelligence and automation tools applied to economic analysis and information processing. (Preferred)

**Soft Skills**

* Analytical ability and judgment to develop evidence\-based conclusions.
* Ability to synthesize information and communicate complex economic messages to different types of audiences.
* Global perspective and ability to integrate analyses from different countries into a coherent regional narrative.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in international and multidisciplinary environments.
* Ability to coordinate and manage stakeholders, with a results\-oriented approach, initiative and appropriate prioritization.
* Intellectual curiosity and interest in methodological innovation and new technologies applied to economic analysis.
* Rigorous and responsible approach to identifying and communicating macroeconomic risks.

Meta's mission is to give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. Through our family of apps and services, we're building a different kind of company that connects billions of people around the world, gives them ways to share what matters most to them, and helps bring people closer together. Whether we're creating new products or helping a small business expand its reach, people at Meta are builders at heart. Our global teams are constantly iterating, solving problems, and working together to empower people around the world to build community and connect in meaningful ways. Together, we can help people build stronger communities — we're just getting started.Meta seeks a motivated and organized team player to join our European Privacy and Data Policy team. You will work on strategic engagement and outreach with privacy and data policy stakeholders in the EU. This will involve working on cutting\-edge data policy issues and building relationships with key stakeholders. The role will involve proactive policy development, project management, and the creation of networks across different sectors. You will work in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment and present to both internal and external audiences. This role involves working on novel public policy issues. In this role you will combine substantive policy expertise with programme leadership: shaping and executing our external engagement strategy with regulators, policymakers, academics and civil society across the EU privacy and AI community, and translating the fast\-moving EU digital rulebook — GDPR, the AI Act, DSA, DMA, Data Act and the EU data strategy more broadly — into clear guidance and priorities for internal partners.The ideal candidate has a track record of public engagement (e.g., published thought leadership, conference speaking, or advisory roles) in the EU data and privacy community and is comfortable operating independently at senior levels both externally and internally. They will be detail\-oriented and strategic, able to adapt quickly, build credibility and trust across all levels of the organisation, and coordinate with cross\-functional leads on time\- and mission\-critical issues spanning policy, legal, communications, product, and engineering. This person will be highly organised, resilient and effective at prioritizing competing demands and delivering results in time\-sensitive scenarios and reports to the Director of Data and Privacy Policy, EMEA.  

  

  

### **Privacy and Data Policy Manager Responsibilities:**

* Policy leadership and external engagement
* Identify and monitor data policy issues affecting Meta in the EU
* Monitor, analyse and advise on EU and national developments in privacy, data governance and AI regulation, and assess implications for Meta's products and policy positions
* Develop proactive strategies and initiatives to address policy challenges
* Engage and build relationships with relevant stakeholders, with regulators, policymakers, academia, civil society and industry bodies in the country of hire and across the EU
* Represent Meta at meetings and conferences
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams on a range of policy issues, including strategically drafting submissions and engagement plans for local policy audiences
* Programme and process management
* Own project plans and strategic planning frameworks for privacy and AI external engagement initiatives
* Provide a centralised view across the privacy team of global external engagement activity
* Drive escalated issues on priorities, goals, strategies, resourcing and key initiatives to resolution
* Partner with events and policy programmes teams to develop and execute event strategy
* Communications and knowledge management
* Shape internal communication strategies and channels on privacy and AI external engagement, in coordination with global counterparts
* Prepare briefing materials and presentations for senior audiences, including leadership policy and business updates on engagement and sentiment
* Build and run knowledge\-sharing processes for the engagement team, acting as subject matter expert for content and knowledge management best practices

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6\+ years of professional experience in privacy, data or technology policy, regulatory affairs, or a closely related field
* Fluency in English and French, as the role requires direct engagement with French\-speaking regulators and policymakers in the EU
* Bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant fields
* Demonstrated expertise in AI policy and in the privacy and data protection framework of the EU digital landscape (GDPR, AI Act, DSA/DMA, Data Act)
* Established familiarity with and a network in the data and privacy community in at least one of the countries where the position may be based (Spain, France, Italy)
* Proven experience leading complex, cross\-functional programmes, including business process management, workflow and lifecycle management
* Strong presentation, writing, and stakeholder\-management skills, including those with senior external audiences

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience advising product or engineering teams on regulatory requirements
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimise/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Track record of published thought leadership or public speaking on privacy or AI policy
* Additional official EU languages to support stakeholder engagement across EU member states
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience working with or within an EU data protection authority, the EDPB, a national digital regulator, or an EU institution
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Regional Chains Director
description:
**About WebBeds**



Launched in 2013, WebBeds is a global marketplace for the travel trade, providing powerful distribution solutions that make selling and buying travel products easier. It sources accommodation and destination services from travel suppliers, aggregates and merchandises that content in the WebBeds platform, then distributes it to its global network of travel trade buyers, who sell to the travelling public.  

Hotels and other suppliers \- global and regional hotel chains, independent hotels, apartments, resorts, attractions, transfer and sightseeing companies and more \- can sell their products to a global network of online and offline travel buyers through robust solutions that provide greater inventory control to simplify distribution, and leverage WebBeds enhanced analytics to inform inventory optimisation choices – saving costs and increasing revenue.

  

Travel buyers \- online travel agencies, retail travel agents, corporate travel managers, tour operators, wholesalers, tourism boards, super apps, DMC’s, group providers, airlines and more \- can integrate the hundreds of thousands of hotels and ground services in the WebBeds marketplace through simple and seamless API connectivity, or they can search, shop and book online through one of WebBeds trade only booking sites.

  

WebBeds operates globally through four geographic regions – Europe, Asia Pacific, MEA (Middle East and Africa) and Americas \- with over 1,900 travel professionals working in 120 cities across 50 countries worldwide.

  

Find out more about the WebBeds business at www.webbeds.com  

WebBeds is a travel brand of the Web Travel Group (ASX: WEB).


**How will you make an impact?**



The Regional Chains Director is responsible for leading, developing, and executing the regional chain strategy to drive sustainable growth, strengthen strategic partnerships, and increase WebBeds’ market share across assigned regions.



This role owns the senior\-level relationships with key regional hotel chain partners and provides strategic direction to the Regional Chains team to maximize commercial performance, portfolio expansion, and long\-term value creation.



Working cross\-functionally with Global Chains, Contracting, Partner Success, Supplier Optimization, Connectivity, Sales, and Marketing teams, the Director ensures alignment between regional execution and global chain objectives. The role requires a strong commercial leader with deep industry expertise, strategic vision, and the ability to translate high\-level strategy into measurable results.



You will:


* Define and own the regional chain strategy, aligned with global chains objectives, to drive incremental revenue growth and market share.
* Lead and manage the Regional Chains team (\>4FTE), providing direction, coaching, and performance management to ensure delivery of agreed KPIs.
* Own senior\-level relationships with priority regional and global hotel chains, acting as executive sponsor and escalation point.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new chain opportunities within the region in collaboration with Global Chains and Regional Leadership.

* Drive regional chain portfolio performance through pricing, availability, inventory, and product optimization in partnership with Partner Success, Supplier Optimization, and Contracting teams. Chair and participate in high\-level quarterly business reviews with key chain partners to review performance, align strategy, and identify growth opportunities.
* Collaborate with regional and destination contracting teams to ensure alignment on chain strategies, targets, and hotel\-level execution.
* Partner with supplier connectivity and loading teams to define preferred connectivity strategies and ensure scalable, high\-quality chain onboarding.
* Monitor regional chain performance trends, risks, and opportunities, using data\-driven insights to inform strategic decisions.
* Act as escalation point for complex commercial, service, or operational issues impacting regional chain partners.
* Drive the negotiation and execution of regional exclusives, value adds, overrides, and joint marketing initiatives across WebBeds platforms.
* Represent WebBeds at key industry events, tradeshows, and executive\-level partner meetings to strengthen market presence and relationships.
* Ensure effective internal communication and alignment between Global Chains, Sales, Marketing, and regional teams to maximize promotion of chain content.
* Support Health and Safety compliance and ensure required reporting is completed and up to date.
* Communicate internally and externally in a professional manner in line with corporate guidelines and leadership expectations.


**The skills we would love to see in your suitcase!**


* Extensive contracting and commercial experience within the hotel and/or travel industry.
* Proven ability to build, manage, and grow senior\-level strategic partnerships with hotel chains.
* Educated to degree level or equivalent professional qualification.
* Fluent in English (additional regional languages highly beneficial).
* Willingness to travel frequently within the region and internationally as required.
* Strong strategic leadership and people management skills, with experience leading multi\-market or regional teams.
* Excellent commercial acumen with a strong understanding of regional and global distribution models.
* Highly developed negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Data\-driven decision\-maker with strong analytical capabilities and financial awareness.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, able to engage effectively at executive level.
* Proactive, resilient, and adaptable, with the ability to manage complexity and competing priorities. Collaborative leadership style with a strong focus on cross\-functional teamwork and accountability.
* Minimum 8–10 years’ experience in hotel contracting, chain management, or strategic commercial roles within OTAs, bedbanks, or tour operators.
* Strong understanding of dynamic and static contracting models across multiple regions. Fluency in one or more additional European languages.


**Why choose us as your next destination?**



We are super proud of our dedicated team of friendly, energetic \& passionate professionals. Our people are key to the success of our business \& everybody at WebBeds has their own unique role to play as we continue to drive the company forward.



Over 50 different languages are spoken by our workforce, but whether working from offices in Dubai or London or out in the field in Johannesburg or Buenos Aires, we all share the common goal to take pride in what we do \& to deliver our partners with unbeatable service \& support.


International highly skilled group of experts from all around the globe
Dynamic environment with the chance to grow, influence \& impact change
Disruptive, fast\-growing market leader within travel \& endless possibilities
Culture built on collaboration empowerment and innovation
  

Find out more about the WebBeds business at www.webbeds.com \- **\#LI\-Hybrid**

* Experience in trades, home services, or a similar service industry

* Familiarity with subscription or membership\-based models
* A background in customer service, office management, or business coordination

**What You'll Get**

* Real autonomy — you'll own the operation, not just sit in it
* A genuine growth path in a business that's scaling quickly

Send your CV and a short note telling us why you'd be brilliant in this role.

title: Senior Logistics Specialist
location: Sant Boi de Llobregat, CT, ES
description:
#### **About Stark Future**


Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road\-legal VARG EX \& SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.


We’re based in Sant Boi, Barcelona, growing fast (77% year\-on\-year), and building a team that will take us even further. If you want to work on a product that people are genuinely obsessed with, this is it.


Stark will become the global market leader in premium motorcycles. Building premium motorcycles requires innovation and we need your help to make us succeed.


Our mission is to lead the way towards a sustainable motorcycle industry, by reducing plastic and CO2 pollution.


This will be achieved by building sustainable products that are superior to traditional technology in terms of Performance, Emotion and Design.

#### **The Role**


Our Logistics team keeps Stark’s global flows moving every day, in both directions and across every market we sell in. It’s a fast, hands\-on operation, and it’s growing quickly.


We’re looking for a Senior Logistics Specialist to strengthen it. You’ll work across our flows end to end (including the returns and reverse flows that come with a product built around batteries) sorting out what’s stuck today, improving what keeps getting stuck, and making sure the way we work keeps us on the right side of customs and battery shipping rules without slowing us down.


You’ll sit alongside our Inbound and Outbound Managers, reporting to the Global Logistics Manager. You won’t manage a team, but you’ll be one of the people this operation relies on.

#### **What You’ll Do**

**Keep the operation moving**

* Get involved where flows are blocked, delayed or going wrong, and see them through to resolution
* Work directly with our transport partners and warehouses to sort out problems and keep them sorted
* Keep the teams who depend on us \- Production, Sales and Aftersales \- informed when something is at risk, before they have to ask
* Make sure our logistics data reflects what’s actually happening, so decisions are made on something real

**Own our reverse flows**

* Take ownership of returns and reverse logistics end to end: bikes, parts and batteries coming back from dealers and customers
* Set up and run the process for returning, moving and storing batteries safely and compliantly, including damaged and end\-of\-life packs
* Work with Aftersales and Quality so warranty and defective returns move quickly instead of sitting in a corner of a warehouse
* Manage the flows to our recycling and repair partners, and keep the documentation and traceability behind them in order
* Build reverse logistics into something planned and measured, rather than something that happens to us

**Improve how we work**

* Find where our flows lose time, money and service quality, and fix the causes rather than the symptoms
* Simplify and standardise the way we do things, and document it so it holds when people are away or new people join
* Cut out manual steps and duplicated work, and push for the right tools where a process needs one
* Track how we’re performing in cost, transit time, reliability and use it to argue for change

**Keep goods clearing borders without drama**

* Keep shipments moving through customs and when something gets held, get it released and then fix whatever caused it
* Make sure the paperwork is right first time by improving how it’s produced, rather than correcting it shipment by shipment
* Work with our brokers and forwarders to sort out clearances quickly, and make sure the same problem doesn’t come back next month
* Keep our battery shipments running properly with the partners who handle them: packaging, labelling and declarations that hold up wherever they land
* Turn the rules we have to follow into simple ways of working the team can apply without thinking twice

#### **What You Bring**

**Required**

* 5\+ years in international logistics, transport or distribution, with real hands\-on operational experience
* Experience with customs procedures, export/import documentation and Incoterms
* Experience working with freight forwarders, carriers and warehouse partners, and holding them to what they promised
* ERP experience, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
* The instinct to fix the cause rather than the symptom, and the persistence to see it through
* Fluent English

**Nice to have**

* Spanish
* Experience shipping dangerous goods, particularly lithium batteries (UN3480 / UN3566\) under ADR, IATA or IMDG — or the appetite to get certified in it
* Experience with returns, warranty flows or reverse logistics
* Experience with BI tools, dashboards or workflow automation

#### **Why Stark**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* 30 days paid vacation
* Subsidised in\-house restaurant
* Free gym access, including weekends
* Direct access to our products, riders and race teams
* A creative, international team based in Sant Boi
* A logistics function growing fast enough that what you build here will still be running in three years

title: VAC_79_2026 - LABORATORY TECHNICIAN
description:
The Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute (IJC) is a comprehensive **cancer research center** dedicated to conduct research and drive innovation in the epidemiological, preventive, clinical, translational, and basic aspects of leukaemia and other hematologic malignancies, with the final aim of finding a cure for these diseases. It was created in 2010, and since then has experienced an exponential growth.


The IJC is also part of the network of Excellence Research Centers of Catalonia **(CERCA)** and was accredited as a **Severo Ochoa Center of Excellence** by the Ministry of Science, Innovation, and Universities in 2024\. Since 2018, the Institute has also been accredited by the Scientific Foundation of the Spanish Association Against Cancer **(FCAECC)** Additionally, IJC is one of the centers integrated into the Institut de Recerca Germans Trias i Pujol (IGTP) accreditation as Accredited Health Research Institute (IIS) by the Carlos III Health Institute **(ISCIII)**.


The IJC's main headquarters is located within the Can Ruti Biomedical Campus, alongside other leading biomedical institutions, providing direct access to cutting\-edge scientific and technological facilities, as well as complementary community services. The IJC has **six locations integrated into reference hospitals**: Hospital Germans Trias i Pujol, Hospital Clínic, Hospital Sant Pau, Hospital Josep Trueta, Hospital del Mar and Hospital San Joan de Déu. This facilitates close collaboration between basic and clinical researchers, fostering translational research that integrates basic science with clinical practice in clinical settings.


The Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute (IJC) is looking for a Predoctoral Researcher for the Stem cells and cancer group led by Dr. Anna Bigas.

**RESEARCH DESCRIPTION**


Our research group investigates how to generate and maintain the stem cells in the hematopoietic system under physiological conditions but also how these processes are mimicked by the tumors for their perpetuation. We constantly improve our research by implementing novel technology to understand the process of normal and malignant hematopoietic development. Our research includes basic studies at the molecular level to understand cellular processes in the context of mouse models and human patients.

**MAIN RESPONSABILITIES**

* Experimental design, execution and analysis for stem cell biology projects
* Perform and supervise cell culture of human and mouse stem cells (ES, iPSC, HSC), genetic transgenesis, cell engineering.
* Training of students in basic cell biology and student supervision
* Lab organization and maintenance, record\-keeping, and inventory.
* Upkeeping of laboratory standard operating procedures and safety protocols.
* Experimental support of individual sub\-projects as needed.
* Organizing meetings/workshops/seminars related to the project.
* To identify and contribute to the formulation of additional project proposals, and to contribute to the strategic research line of the group development.
* To establish and coordinate scientific relationships with other international groups/institutions.

**WHAT WE NEED**

* A degree in Biological sciencies, Biomedicine or similar.
* At least 5 years of professional experience in positions relevant to the job description.
* Managing experience in a laboratory environment, and knowledge of key operations, basic instrumentation, and safety procedures.
* Excellent organizational, management, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to teamwork in a dynamic environment and to handle varying workloads.
* Experience in training and coordinating other scientists.
* Great organizational abilities and teamwork and training skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English.
* A good track record of scientific publications, and project presentations in international settings.
* Enthusiasm, pro\-activity, impeccable work ethics and professionalism. Ability to manage multiple and competing tasks and responsibilities.
* Commitment to an equity, diversity and inclusion\-based, international working environment, and student training.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Temporary contract (IACT).
* Full time contract of 39 hours per week.
* Measures to reconcile work and family life (flexible work schedule, 23 working days of vacation and days for personal matters).
* Flexible remuneration program (kindergarten and other measures).
* An exciting and innovative research project.
* Working in the mixed basic and clinical research environment of the Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute.
* Incorporation in a multinational and highly collaborative team.
* The stimulating environment of the Barcelona metropolitan area.

**DEADLINE**


Please submit your application by October 01, 2026

**WHO WE ARE?**

###### ***What makes us different?***

  

The mission of the Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute is to conduct research and drive innovation in the epidemiological, preventive, clinical, translational, and basic aspects of cancer, with a special emphasis on Leukaemia and other malignant blood diseases, with the aim of finding a cure for these diseases.  

The IJC’s vision is to be a world\-class reference and excellent research center that contributes to the improvement of results, and the cure of patients affected by leukaemia and other malignant haemopathies, through innovation, sustainability, social responsibility, talent, and professional experience.

###### ***HR Excellence***


In 2019, IJC was honored with the “Human Resources Excellence in Research Award” by the European Commission, recognizing the alignment of our human resources policies with the European Charter for Researchers and Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers. The Human Resources Strategy for Researchers (HRS4R) guides research centers of excellence in implementing and upholding these standards within their policies, emphasizing training, professional development, and mobility opportunities.
  

The IJC’s commitment to these values and principles strengthens our internal policies and ensures that our members have the optimal conditions and environment for their professional development.  

The Board of Trustees is composed of representatives of the Generalitat de Catalunya (regional government), University of Barcelona, Autonomous University of Barcelona, the City of Badalona and the Jose Carreras International Leukaemia Foundation  

The Catalan government provides hard money on an annual basis. The Jose Carreras International Leukaemia Foundation provides start\-up funds, project funds as well as financial support for investments.  

The JCI has an international scientific advisory board served by prominent researchers from US and Europe.  

The IJC has been awarded ERC and other EU grants.

**The IJC is an equal\-opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or other legally protected characteristics.**

title: Global Security Architect, Madrid
description:
Global Security Architect
  
The role sits in engineering. It reports to the Head of Information Security for mandate and standards, and spends its days with the teams that build the products, in the architecture forum, in design reviews, and alongside the Security Champions it coordinates. Its measure of success is that new products and material changes are secure by design, and that the same control is not reinvented twice.
  
  

Accountabilities
  
**Own the reference security patterns for Infronts products:** authentication and authorisation, encryption and key handling, secrets management, logging and telemetry, and secure service\-to\-service communication. Publish them, keep them current, and see them adopted.
  
Own the Secure Development Standard and the security gates in the build and deployment pipeline, including continuous scanning that covers components embedded in Infronts own software, not only what is installed on hosts.
  
Lead threat modelling and security design review for new products and material changes, proportionate to risk, and record the outcome so it is auditable.
  
Be the technical lead for identity architecture across the estate: the enterprise identity provider, the product authentication platform and the trading authorisation layer, including succession planning for platforms that today depend on a single person.
  
Own security architecture for the cloud estate, across multiple AWS accounts and Azure tenants, and for the boundary between shared and isolated platform instances.
  
Coordinate the Security Champions, one named engineer per product area, as a dotted\-line community: set their agenda, give them patterns to apply, and use them to reach every team.
  
Represent security in the architecture forum and in the Cyber Resilience Act secure\-by\-design work, and translate regulatory expectations into engineering decisions.
  
Provide the application\-layer input to vulnerability prioritisation and penetration test scoping, so that testing concentrates on the shared components most products depend on.
  
  

What you will do in the first six months
  
Publish the first three reference patterns, encryption, authentication and secrets, and get them adopted by at least one product team each.
  
Enable continuous pipeline scanning for embedded components across the priority products, with a named owner for findings in each team.
  
Produce the identity architecture and succession plan for the product authentication and authorisation platforms.
  
Stand up the Security Champions community with a named champion in every product area and a monthly cadence.
  
Consolidate Infronts four overlapping secure development policy drafts into one standard that engineers will actually use.
  
Complete threat models for the five shared components on which most priority products depend.
  
Experience and skills, essential
  
Substantial experience designing security into software products, in a company that builds and operates its own platforms, ideally financial technology or another regulated SaaS environment.
  
**Hands\-on depth in application security and secure development:** threat modelling, OWASP\-aligned secure coding, SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI/CD, and what it takes to get engineers to adopt them.
  
Cloud security architecture across AWS and Azure, including multi\-account governance, container platforms and infrastructure as code.
  
**Identity and access architecture:** enterprise identity providers, single sign\-on, OAuth and OIDC, and product\-level authentication platforms of the Keycloak type.
  
**Cryptography applied in practice:** what to use, where, and how to manage keys and certificates, rather than theory.
  
The credibility to influence engineers without line authority, and the judgement to know when a pattern must be mandatory and when it can be guidance.
  
Fluent English.
  
Familiarity with DORA and the Cyber Resilience Act as they apply to a technology supplier to financial institutions.
  
  

OWASP, SAST, SCA, Cloud Security AWS/Azure, OAuth, OIDC

**Summary of Job Duties:**
--------------------------

The School of Journalism and Strategic Media at the University of Arkansas invites applications for a tenure\-track Assistant Professor position. This hire will serve as the Associate Director of the Center for Media Ethics and Literacy, reporting to the director. We are seeking a scholar whose research and teaching align with our faculty cluster in Democracy, Ethics, and Immigration. The successful candidate will combine scholarly excellence with a commitment to public engagement and pedagogical innovation within a rapidly growing School of Journalism. This is a standard nine\-month academic appointment.
  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

Research \& Center Leadership:
  

* Center Administration: Serve as the Associate Director of the center, providing strategic leadership to the College and the University.
* Scholarly Production: Produce high\-impact scholarly research in the fields of media ethics, literacy and theory, especially news literacy, civic engagement, and democratic practices.
* Public Engagement: Actively engage and educate the public and industry professionals on ethics and literacy issues in the news cycle through the Center’s website, social media platforms, and other public\-facing initiatives.
* External Support: Pursue external research support (grants, fellowships, etc.) to advance the strategic goals of the Center, the School, and the University.

Teaching \& Mentoring:
  

* Instruction: Teach undergraduate and graduate students in the School of Journalism, utilizing innovative media literacy pedagogy and practices to help students navigate the intersection of theoretical ethics and real\-world newsroom challenges, drawing upon professional experience in journalism and reporting.
* Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and advisor to SJSM students.
* Committee Service: Serve on thesis and honors committees and participate in departmental, college, and university governance as appropriate for a tenure\-track faculty rank.

  

Faculty hired in this position will have an opportunity to be a part of Fulbright College’s multidisciplinary Democracy as a Public Good cluster hire at the University of Arkansas. Through its Democracy as a Public Good Initiative, the College will advance the University’s land\-grant mission by expanding capacity to generate knowledge that informs public understanding, contributes to policy and practice, and connects Arkansas to national and international conversations about societal good. Building on existing campus expertise in issues ranging from norms of democratic communication, free speech, media ethics and literacy, humanitarian governance and civil society, risks that AI poses to democratic governance, immigration, and public law, new faculty members participating in the cluster will advance their research agendas through mentoring and opportunities for collaboration—both with other scholars and with communities in the state—that may result in peer\-reviewed publications, external funding, and new approaches to the pressing challenges that democracy faces. The successful candidate for this position will have an opportunity to join a community of scholars committed to confronting major issues, generating new knowledge, and providing research\-based solutions that investigate and strengthen democratic culture for people living in Arkansas and beyond.
  

  

This is an in\-person position. Most university classes are offered face\-to\-face, and extensive in\-person engagement in such activities as office hours, student advising, and departmental, college, and university committee meetings is essential to advancing student success and departmental effectiveness.
  

  

Regular, reliable, and non\-disruptive attendance is an essential job duty, as is the ability to create and maintain collegial, harmonious working relationships with others.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Terminal degree in Journalism, Media Studies, Communication (or a closely related field) from an accredited institution of higher education conferred by the date of initial appointment
* A demonstrated record of exceptional teaching and mentoring at the graduate level and/or undergraduate level, especially journalism\-related courses
* Evidence of, or a demonstrated potential for publishing high\-quality, peer\-reviewed research and a clear vision for Center\-led research initiatives
* Demonstrated experience in journalism and reporting, combined with a strong working knowledge of media\-industry ethical standards and practices and evidence\-based media literacy pedagogy

For more information, visit rwsglobal.com.  

  

**Job Summary**  

Reporting to the Technical Director, the Technical Manager, Sea will be responsible for the end\-to\-end planning and technical delivery of bespoke entertainment and guest experience projects across RWS Global’s cruise portfolio.  

  

The role will lead projects from initial technical concept development through to execution, including themed cruises, immersive live experiences and events, rehearsals, show installations and changeovers, as well as  

cruise ship refits during wet and dry docks, and any other technical projects as required.  

  

The position serves as the primary technical lead for assigned projects, managing budgets, technical schedules,  

stakeholders, vendors, logistics, installation and commissioning activities while ensuring delivery against technical vision, operational requirements and client expectations. The role is responsible for maintaining the  

highest standards of quality, safety, operational excellence and guest experience while driving innovation across  

the Sea division.  

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**  

**Project Leadership \& Delivery*** Lead the end\-to\-end planning, and technical delivery of assigned projects from initial client brief through design, installation, launch and project close\-out.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects across the Sea division while maintaining project scope, schedule, quality and budget expectations.
* Develop and maintain detailed technical calendars, project plans, critical paths and implementation timelines.
* Maintain accurate project information within Wrike and other company project management systems.
* Conduct post\-project reviews and project evaluations to support continuous improvement.

**Projects \& Guest Experiences*** Lead the technical delivery of themed cruises, immersive live experiences and events, rehearsals, show installations and changeovers, as well as cruise ship refits during wet and dry docks, and any other technical projects as required.
* Partner with Creative, Production, Entertainment, Operations and Client teams to develop concepts into operationally deliverable guest experiences.
* Ensure all projects maintain the original technical artistic intention, creative integrity and brand standards of both RWS Global and the client.
* Support innovation initiatives by researching emerging technical trends and guest experience concepts.
* Support the wider technical operations team with any other business as required

**Budget \& Financial Management*** Contribute to and assist with the effective management of project budgets, ensuring projects remain profitable and within budget.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of project budgets, forecasts and financial tracking documents.
* Assist with project quotations, purchase orders, payment schedules and budget reconciliations.
* Monitor project spend and proactively identify opportunities for efficiencies and cost savings without compromising quality.

**Vendor \& Supplier Management*** Source, negotiate and manage external suppliers, contractors and specialist vendors.
* Manage relationships throughout the design, build and delivery process.
* Oversee sourcing \& procurement of all technical equipment and bespoke project assets.
* Research and source bespoke and off\-the\-shelf technical assets as required.

**Technical Production \& Installation*** Oversee technical production requirements including scenic elements, lighting, audio, video, media systems, special effects and interactive technologies.
* Coordinate and manage onboard and shoreside installation activities.
* Conduct vessel surveys, site visits and technical assessments as required.
* Lead installation, testing, commissioning and operational handover of new experiences and entertainment products.

**Logistics \& Operations*** Liaising with the Logistics Department, manage the project logistics, freight coordination and global shipment of project assets.
* Coordinate installation schedules and operational requirements with vessel leadership and client stakeholders.
* Support project staffing plans and onboard resource allocation as required.
* Travel to vessels and project locations globally to support project delivery, installations and operational launches.

**Stakeholder \& Client Management*** Act as the primary technical contact for assigned projects.
* Provide regular progress updates to clients, senior leadership and internal stakeholders.
* Facilitate project meetings and maintain clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.
* Collaborate closely with Creative, Production, Operations and Client Services teams to ensure project success.

**Risk, Compliance \& Safety*** Identify, assess and mitigate project risks and develop contingency plans where required.
* Ensure compliance with company standards, client requirements, maritime regulations and health and safety policies.
* Maintain all project documentation including budgets, schedules, approvals and technical specifications.
* Ensure all installations and project deliverables meet operational and safety requirements prior to launch.

* Proven experience managing complex projects from concept through implementation.
* Experience delivering immersive experiences, themed environments, installations, activations or large scale technical entertainment projects.

We are seeking an experienced Architect or Architectural Technologist with a strong technical background in the design of large multi\-disciplinary design projects, preferably data centres. The ideal candidate will be able to collaborate effectively within multi\-disciplinary architectural and engineering teams.


The candidate must be strong in technical design content, with a CSA bias and in design management, digital technologies, and design workflow. They will be expected to oversee design activities and the production of design information and maintain the level of quality that is expected throughout these projects. They will have to manage this delivery to very demanding timelines and programmes with immovable deadlines.


The preferred location for this role is Belfast, given its position as a key hub of expertise. Dublin, Manchester, and London are also suitable locations. The role will require travel throughout the UK, Ireland, and Europe.

*AECOM is listed as the 4th largest employer of architects worldwide in the World Architecture WA100 2025 survey, with over 1500 architects. We are currently expanding in the UK, so now is a great time to join our team and build your career for the future. We are at number 10 in the AJ100 list. AECOM employs around 7500 multi\-disciplinary staff in the UK, and we offer architecturally led multi\-disciplinary design services to our clients.*  

  

**Project / Design Responsibilities**

* Senior Architect/Designer on a portfolio of projects.
* Assist in coordinating the design across multi\-disciplinary architectural and engineering teams, working closely with discipline leads to deliver integrated architectural and engineering outputs across projects.
* Ensuring all internal governance is followed both at bid stage and throughout the delivery of projects.
* Presenting to clients and prospective clients.
* Ensuring CDM Safety in Design principles are applied throughout all design stages of a project.

**Managerial Responsibilities**

* Organises own and others work to achieve set deadlines.
* Responsible for the correctness, accuracy and multi\-disciplinary coordination of the design documentation.
* Ensures the quality of technical work produced meets AECOM’s Technical Excellence standards.
* Interact with clients, contractors, local authority representatives and others using skills of persuasion and negotiation to resolve critical issues.
* Make appropriate value judgements with respect to corrective work that supports the design concept and performance goals of the project.
* For projects on site: Manage interface between Design Team / Site Team ensuring proper design support is provided in a timely manner.
* Support Associate Directors and / or Directors with operational responsibilities which includes development and implementing Technical Excellence initiatives, management of resources (HR), training initiatives (CPD).
* Where requested, engage with business reporting activities.
* Ensure the latest software and digital techniques are utilised to increase productivity and identify where training opportunities for staff should be made available.

**Specific Skills Required:**

* Must be proficient in the team management of, and use of, CAD. We use a range of CAD software, and training can be given to get you up to speed on the specific software needed for projects we are working on, which utilise AutoCAD \& REVIT.
* In particular our approach to design utilises 3D modelling in REVIT for workflow, and direct ‘hands on’ experience and current working knowledge of REVIT is required.
* It would also be useful to have a working knowledge of Sketchup, Photoshop, InDesign, PowerPoint, Twinmotion and other presentation and render software. (Training can also be provided).
* Familiarity with working in Common Data Environments (CDE) like Forma ACC, ProjectWise, Autodesk Docs, etc.
* Creative, practical, adaptable and enthusiastic.
* Ability to demonstrate attention to detail.
* Ability to think in a methodical way to design, plan and organize parts of projects.
* English language proficient, holding good communication skills to present information in speech, drawings and reports.
* Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Fully Qualified Architect or Technologist (Chartered or equivalent) and proven experience in working on large multi\-disciplinary design projects, preferably in Data Centres
* Willingness and interest to work in a range of areas under the guidance of Associate Directors and / or Directors. Our areas of design include: Data Centres, Nuclear, Transport, Rail, Aviation, Education, Health Care, Laboratory, Science, and Logistics.
* Degree qualification, preferably with Diploma or Masters in a University Course, although the latter is not absolutely essential.
* Some experience of various forms of building contract will be helpful.

title: Senior Couture Pattern Maker & Sample Maker ( freelance )
description:
Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker

We are looking for a freelancer highly experienced and technically skilled Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker to join our fashion atelier.

The ideal candidate must be able to take a design from concept or sketch through the full garment\-development process, including pattern making, draping, fabric cutting, garment construction, fitting, alterations, and couture\-level finishing.

This role requires someone with strong technical knowledge, excellent craftsmanship, and the ability to work independently on complex womenswear and couture pieces.

Key Responsibilities

\* Interpret fashion sketches, reference images, and creative direction and translate them into technically feasible garments.

\* Create accurate patterns from sketches, measurements, existing garments, or draped toile.

\* Draping directly on the mannequin to develop silhouettes, volume, gathers, pleats, asymmetric shapes, and flowing designs.

\* Prepare toiles and prototypes for fitting and development.

\* Cut fabrics accurately, including delicate and luxury materials such as silk, chiffon, organza, satin, lace, tulle, crepe, and other couture fabrics.

\* Construct complete garments from first sample through final piece.

\* Perform both machine sewing and high\-quality hand sewing.

\* Apply couture finishing techniques, including invisible hems, hand finishing, internal finishing, delicate closures, and clean seam construction.

\* Understand garment structure, balance, fit, proportion, and movement.

\* Conduct fittings and make necessary pattern and garment adjustments.

\* Develop solutions for internal garment support, boning, lining, interfacing, corsetry, and structured areas when required.

\* Work carefully with complex draping, bias\-cut garments, layered fabrics, and intricate silhouettes.

\* Ensure every garment meets a very high standard of craftsmanship, fit, and finishing.

\* Recommend appropriate construction methods based on the design and selected fabric.

\* Minimize fabric waste while maintaining accurate cutting and quality.

\* Maintain organized patterns, samples, and garment\-development records.

\* Work closely with the Creative Director to develop and refine each design while maintaining the original creative vision.

Required Experience \& Skills

\* Strong professional experience in couture, bridal, eveningwear, luxury womenswear, or high\-end bespoke fashion.

\* Advanced pattern\-making skills.

\* Advanced draping skills.

\* Excellent fabric\-cutting ability.

\* Excellent machine\-sewing and hand\-sewing skills.

\* Strong understanding of garment construction and couture finishing.

\* Ability to work with delicate, expensive, and difficult fabrics.

\* Strong knowledge of women’s garment fitting and alterations.

\* Ability to understand a sketch and independently determine how the garment should be constructed.

\* Experience creating samples and prototypes from the development stage through the final garment.

\* Excellent attention to detail and precision.

\* Strong problem\-solving skills when translating creative designs into wearable garments.

\* Ability to work independently and manage several designs during collection development.

Preferred

\* Experience working in a couture atelier, bridal house, luxury fashion house, or bespoke studio.

\* Experience with evening gowns, draped dresses, corsetry, and complex silhouettes.

\* Knowledge of embroidery, embellishment, fabric manipulation, and hand\-applied details is an advantage.

\* Experience developing garments from original designer sketches rather than only following existing patterns.

What We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone who is not limited to one technical area. The candidate should be capable of managing the complete garment\-development process:

Sketch → Draping / Pattern Making → Toile → Fitting → Pattern Correction → Cutting → Sewing → Couture Finishing → Final Garment

The right candidate should combine technical expertise with an understanding of design, proportion, movement, and luxury craftsmanship.

Pay: AED500\.00 \- AED5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dubai (Dubai)

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Associate Director, Patient Engagement**

**Sponsor‑Dedicated Role / Remote \- US Based**  

**\*\*Direct Pharmaceutical Experience Required\*\***

**Redefine How Patients Shape Drug Development**
------------------------------------------------


This is a rare opportunity to lead patient‑focused drug development **from the inside of a pharmaceutical organization**, while being supported by the global scale and innovation engine of **Syneos Health**.


As **Associate Director, Patient Engagement**, you will serve as a strategic leader embedded within a sponsor’s clinical development organization, responsible for integrating the patient voice across the full development lifecycle—from **early molecule strategy through clinical execution and evidence generation**. Your work will directly influence how trials are designed, how patients experience participation, and how development decisions are made at an enterprise level.


This is **not a support or execution‑only role**. It is a **visible, high‑influence, sponsor‑side position** requiring hands‑on experience leading **patient engagement and patient recruitment strategies within a pharmaceutical company**. Experience limited to CROs, investigative sites, agencies, or service providers **does not meet the requirements** of this role.

**What You Will Drive**
-----------------------

* A global strategy for **patient‑focused trial design, patient experience enhancement, and patient‑centered evidence generation**
* **Sponsor‑side patient recruitment and retention strategies** embedded directly into clinical development planning and execution
* Patient journey analytics, inclusion frameworks, and **co‑designed engagement initiatives** that improve recruitment performance, reduce participant burden, and increase trial satisfaction
* Strategies to strengthen **representation and inclusion** across therapeutic areas and geographies
* Enterprise‑level change management to **scale patient engagement capabilities**, standardize best practices, and modernize the clinical trial experience
* Cross‑functional collaboration with Clinical Operations, Clinical Research, Regulatory, Data Science, Medical Affairs, Public Affairs, Commercial, and Corporate Affairs
* Strategic input into policy and regulatory initiatives related to **PFDD, PFMD, the 21st Century Cures Act, PDUFA VII, digital health, and real‑world evidence**
* Engagement with **patient advocacy groups, caregivers, and external stakeholders** to support long‑term trust and advocacy

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------


Patient engagement is no longer optional—it is a **competitive differentiator** in drug development. Regulatory expectations, digital innovation, real‑world data, and patient advocacy are reshaping how clinical programs are evaluated and rewarded.


In this role, you won’t react to that change—you’ll **lead it**.


You will help ensure that patient perspectives are not an afterthought, but a **core pillar of how development decisions are made**, improving trial feasibility, regulatory confidence, participant experience, and overall development outcomes.

**Why Join Us**
---------------


Sponsor‑Dedicated Impact, Powered by Syneos


This role is **fully sponsor‑dedicated**, meaning you operate as an embedded leader within a pharmaceutical organization—participating in real development decisions, governance discussions, and cross‑functional planning—not as an external vendor.


At the same time, as part of **Syneos Health**, you gain access to a global organization known for advancing **patient‑centric innovation at scale**, including industry‑leading capabilities in data science, digital health, real‑world evidence, and patient engagement methodology.

**The Best of Both Worlds**

* **True sponsor‑side ownership** of patient engagement and recruitment strategy
* **Long‑term impact**, building scalable capabilities within a single sponsor portfolio
* **Innovation at scale**, leveraging Syneos’ tools, insights, and cross‑industry expertise
* A career‑defining opportunity to be recognized as a leader in **patient‑focused drug development**


If you want to shape how patient voice becomes operational reality—not just a philosophy—this role delivers that platform.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Patient insights are embedded in **protocol design, endpoint selection, and development strategy**
* Recruitment and retention improve because trials are **designed with patients, not just for them**
* Patient engagement approaches are **consistent, scalable, and measurable** across programs
* The sponsor is recognized internally and externally as a leader in patient‑focused development

**What You Bring**
------------------

***Required***

* 5\+ years of experience in patient engagement, patient recruitment, or patient‑centric clinical trial strategy **within a pharmaceutical company**
* Demonstrated experience influencing cross‑functional leaders and driving enterprise change
* Strong understanding of global clinical development, regulatory frameworks, and operational decision‑making
* Proven ability to design and execute **global, multi‑functional patient engagement initiatives**
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific and regulatory concepts into clear strategy

***Preferred***

* Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Data Science, Information Technology, or related field
* Experience with digital health solutions, real‑world data, and patient engagement technology
* Prior leadership of large, global clinical development programs or transformation initiatives

**This Role Is Not a Fit If…**
------------------------------

* Your experience is limited to **CRO, site‑level, agency, or services‑vendor roles**
* You have not owned patient engagement or recruitment strategy **from within a pharmaceutical sponsor**
* You are seeking rotational project work rather than **deep, sponsor‑embedded leadership**

**Take the Lead in Patient‑Focused Development**
------------------------------------------------

**If you have driven patient engagement** **from inside a pharmaceutical organization** **and are ready to shape how patients influence the future of medicine—while backed by the innovation and scale of Syneos Health—this role offers a rare and meaningful opportunity.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Fabletics** is looking for a **Director, Design – Concept, Color, Print \& Graphics.**

**How do you fit in?**

As the **Director, Design – Concept, Color, Print \& Graphics** , you will drive the overall seasonal concept, color, print, and graphic strategy for Fabletics Women's and Men's businesses. Leading a team of Color, Print, and Graphic Designers, you will create compelling seasonal creative direction that is trend\-relevant, commercially viable, aligned with our brand identity, and created for our members.


You will bring excellence in creativity, leadership, color and print expertise, and strategic vision, translating broader brand and design direction into cohesive seasonal stories that inform and inspire product creation across categories. You will have a strong understanding of the Fabletics aesthetic and customer, with the ability to balance creative innovation, market relevance, and commercial opportunity.


You will join an extremely fast\-paced team of passionate and energetic creative individuals working towards our vision to be the world's most fashionable, innovative, and inclusive active\-lifestyle brand.


You will report to the **Vice President of Women's Design** and partner closely with **Design Directors, Merchandising, Product Development, Production, Technical Design** , and **Marketing** teams.


**What You Will Do:**

* In partnership with the VPs of Design, create and lead the seasonal concept, color, print, and graphic vision for Fabletics.
